entry.summary: Proposes PPRoute, a privacy-preserving LLM routing framework using Secure Multi-Party Computation with optimized strategies for encoder inference and nearest neighbor search to reduce computational overhead.

entry.title: Self-Distillation as a Performance Recovery Mechanism for LLMs: Counteracting Compression and Catastrophic Forgetting

author.name: Chi Liu, Xin Chen, Xu Zhou, Fangbo Tu, Srinivasan Manoharan

entry.summary: Introduces Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) for recovering LLM performance after compression or catastrophic forgetting, using CKA to analyze and maintain hidden-layer manifold alignment between student and teacher.

entry.title: Continual Hand-Eye Calibration for Open-world Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Fazeng Li, Gan Sun, Chenxi Liu, Yao He, Wei Cong, and Yang Cong

entry.summary: Proposes a continual learning framework for hand-eye calibration in open-world robotics, using spatially-aware replay and structure-preserving distillation to handle catastrophic forgetting when adapting to new scenes.

entry.title: DTEA: A Dual-Topology Elastic Actuator Enabling Real-Time Switching Between Series and Parallel Compliance

author.name: Vishal Ramesh, Aman Singh, and Shishir Kolathaya

entry.summary: Presents DTEA, a novel actuator design enabling real-time switching between Series Elastic Actuator and Parallel Elastic Actuator topologies during operation, demonstrated through 324 switching cycles under load.

entry.title: PolarMAE: Efficient Fetal Ultrasound Pre-training via Semantic Screening and Polar-Guided Masking

author.name: Meng Lv, Yapeng Li, Hang Su, Juhua Liu, Bo Du

entry.summary: Proposes PolarMAE, a pre-training framework tailored for fetal ultrasound images that addresses US-specific characteristics like data redundancy, fan-shaped locality, and polar coordinate beamforming through progressive semantic screening and polar-guided masking.

entry.title: SENSE: Stereo OpEN Vocabulary SEmantic Segmentation

author.name: Thomas Campagnolo (ACENTAURI), Ezio Malis (ACENTAURI), Philippe Martinet (ACENTAURI), Ga\'etan Bahl

entry.summary: Proposes SENSE, the first stereo open-vocabulary semantic segmentation method, leveraging stereo vision paired with vision-language models to introduce geometric cues that improve spatial reasoning and segmentation accuracy.

entry.title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization via Adaptive \varepsilon-Constraints Decomposition

author.name: Yaohong Yang, Sammie Katt, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Proposes STAGE-BO, a multi-objective Bayesian optimization method that explicitly targets under-explored regions of the Pareto front by analyzing coverage gaps and converting them into constrained subproblems.

entry.title: Towards Universal Convergence of Backward Error in Linear System Solvers

author.name: Micha{\l} Derezi\'nski, Yuji Nakatsukasa, Elizaveta Rebrova

entry.summary: Studies backward error convergence in linear system solvers, showing that several iterative methods achieve universal backward error convergence independent of conditioning. Addresses the long-standing open problem of O(n²) linear system solving.

entry.title: Reckoning with the Political Economy of AI: Avoiding Decoys in Pursuit of Accountability

author.name: Janet Vertesi, danah boyd, Alex Taylor, Benjamin Shestakofsky

entry.summary: Critiques the AI industry's use of 'decoys' that create illusion of accountability while masking power dynamics. Argues that scholars, policymakers, and the public are co-opted into industry-empowering AI futures through these mechanisms.

entry.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Radiology Clinical Hierarchy for CT Report Generation

author.name: Yi Lin, Yihao Ding, Yonghui Wu, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Proposes MARCH, a multi-agent framework for CT report generation that emulates radiology department hierarchies with Resident, Fellow, and Attending agents for iterative drafting, revision, and verification of radiology reports.

entry.title: GIST: Multimodal Knowledge Extraction and Spatial Grounding via Intelligent Semantic Topology

author.name: Shivendra Agrawal, Bradley Hayes

entry.summary: GIST transforms mobile point clouds into semantically annotated navigation topologies for dense environments like retail stores, combining VLMs with spatial grounding to enable navigation in cluttered spaces.

entry.title: Learning Affine-Equivariant Proximal Operators

author.name: Oriel Savir, Zhenghan Fang, Jeremias Sulam

entry.summary: Introduces affine-equivariant learned proximal networks (AE-LPNs) that compute exact proximal operators while being equivariant to shifts and scaling, important for signal processing inverse problems.

entry.title: RefereeBench: Are Video MLLMs Ready to be Multi-Sport Referees

author.name: Yichen Xu, Yuanhang Liu, Chuhan Wang, Zihan Zhao, jinghan luo, Jianzhe Ma, Wenxuan Wang, Qin Jin

entry.summary: RefereeBench is the first large-scale benchmark evaluating MLLMs as automatic sports referees across 11 sports with 925 videos and 6,475 QA pairs, testing foul detection, classification, reasoning, entity perception, and temporal grounding.

entry.title: Preference Estimation via Opponent Modeling in Multi-Agent Negotiation

author.name: Yuta Konishi, Kento Yamamoto, Eisuke Sonomoto, Rikuho Takeda, Ryo Furukawa, Yusuke Muraki, Takafumi Shimizu, Kazuma Fukumura, Yuya Kanemoto, Takayuki Ito, Shiyao Ding

entry.summary: Proposes a preference estimation method for multi-agent negotiation that integrates natural language cues from LLMs into a Bayesian opponent modeling framework. Converts qualitative linguistic signals into probabilistic formats for structured preference estimation.

entry.title: Lightweight Geometric Adaptation for Training Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Kang An, Chenhao Si, Shiqian Ma, Ming Yan

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight curvature-aware optimization framework for Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) that uses secant information as a cheap proxy for local geometric change. The plug-and-play method augments first-order optimizers without forming second-order matrices, addressing PINNs' notorious convergence and stability issues.

entry.title: MedGemma vs GPT-4: Open-Source and Proprietary Zero-shot Medical Disease Classification from Images

author.name: Md. Sazzadul Islam Prottasha, Nabil Walid Rafi

entry.summary: Compares MedGemma (fine-tuned with LoRA) against GPT-4 for zero-shot medical image classification across six diseases. MedGemma achieves 80.37% vs GPT-4's 69.58% accuracy, with notably higher sensitivity for critical conditions.

entry.title: Evaluating LLMs as Human Surrogates in Controlled Experiments

author.name: Adnan Hoq, Tim Weninger

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs as surrogates for human participants in survey experiments on accuracy perception. Finds LLMs reproduce directional effects but vary in magnitude and moderation patterns across models.

entry.title: Seeing the imagined: a latent functional alignment in visual imagery decoding from fMRI data

author.name: Fabrizio Spera, Tommaso Boccato, Michal Olak, Sara Cammarota, Matteo Ciferri, Michelangelo Tronti, Nicola Toschi, Matteo Ferrante

entry.summary: Adapts a perception-trained visual brain decoder to reconstruct imagined content from fMRI data using latent functional alignment and retrieval-based augmentation, demonstrating transfer from perception to imagery.

entry.title: Temporal Contrastive Decoding: A Training-Free Method for Large Audio-Language Models

author.name: Yanda Li, Yuhan Liu, Zirui Song, Yunchao Wei, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}, Salem Lahlou

entry.summary: Proposes Temporal Contrastive Decoding (TCD) for large audio-language models, a training-free method that contrasts original and temporally-blurred inputs to mitigate temporal smoothing bias in unified audio decoders.

entry.title: Bureaucratic Silences: What the Canadian AI Register Reveals, Omits, and Obscures

author.name: Dipto Das, Christelle Tessono, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed, Shion Guha

entry.summary: Analyzes Canada's Federal AI Register using the ADMAPS framework, finding that while 86% of systems are deployed internally for efficiency, the register systematically obscures human discretion and training, revealing gaps between rhetoric and practice.

entry.title: Optimizing Stochastic Gradient Push under Broadcast Communications

author.name: Tuan Nguyen and Ting He

entry.summary: Optimizes mixing matrix design for decentralized federated learning under broadcast communications using stochastic gradient push with non-symmetric matrices, enabling directed graph topologies and improved convergence.

entry.title: Natural gradient descent with momentum

author.name: Anthony Nouy and Agust\'in Somacal

entry.summary: Analyzes natural gradient descent with momentum for optimization on nonlinear manifolds (neural networks, tensor networks), providing convergence analysis that connects functional-space updates with practical parameter-space algorithms.

entry.title: DataCenterGym: A Physics-Grounded Simulator for Multi-Objective Data Center Scheduling

author.name: Nilavra Pathak, Samadrita Biswas and Nirmalya Roy

entry.summary: DataCenterGym is a physics-grounded simulation environment for datacenter job scheduling that integrates compute, thermal dynamics, HVAC, and energy sustainability in a Gymnasium-compatible interface with an H-MPC baseline.

entry.title: CLIMB: Controllable Longitudinal Brain Image Generation using Mamba-based Latent Diffusion Model and Gaussian-aligned Autoencoder

author.name: Duy-Phuong Dao and Muhammad Taqiyuddin and Jahae Kim and Sang-Heon Lee and Hye-Won Jung and Jaehoo Choi and Hyung-Jeong Yang

entry.summary: CLIMB generates longitudinal brain MRI scans conditioned on baseline scans, age, gender, disease status, and genetic information using a Mamba-based latent diffusion model with Gaussian-aligned autoencoder.

entry.title: Contact-Aware Planning and Control of Continuum Robots in Highly Constrained Environments

author.name: Aedan Mangan, Kehan Long, Ki Myung Brian Lee, Miheer Potdar, Nikolay Atanasov, and Tania K. Morimoto

entry.summary: Presents contact-aware planning for continuum robots in constrained environments that evaluates contact quality, penalizing hazardous interactions while permitting benign contact, validated on patient anatomy models.

entry.title: HyperGVL: Benchmarking and Improving Large Vision-Language Models in Hypergraph Understanding and Reasoning

author.name: Yanbin Wei, Chun Kang, Siwei Li, Haoxuan Che, Yang Chen, Hua Liu, Jian Liu, Zhuang Liu, Can Ouyang, Fei Xing, Lei Sha, Rui Liu, Yu Zhang, James Kwok

entry.summary: HyperGVL is the first benchmark evaluating Large Vision-Language Models on hypergraph understanding and reasoning, with 84,000 questions across various complexity levels and 12 evaluated models. Results show current LVLMs struggle significantly with hypergraph tasks.

entry.title: PixDLM: A Dual-Path Multimodal Language Model for UAV Reasoning Segmentation

author.name: Shuyan Ke, Yifan Mei, Changli Wu, Yonghan Zheng, Jiayi Ji, Liujuan Cao, and Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: PixDLM defines the UAV Reasoning Segmentation task and introduces DRSeg benchmark with 10K high-resolution aerial images paired with Chain-of-Thought QA supervision. Proposes a pixel-level multimodal language model for reasoning-based segmentation from UAV perspectives.

entry.title: Structured Abductive-Deductive-Inductive Reasoning for LLMs via Algebraic Invariants

author.name: Sankalp Gilda, Shlok Gilda

entry.summary: Presents a symbolic reasoning scaffold operationalizing Peirce's tripartite inference (abduction, deduction, induction) for LLMs, enforcing logical consistency through five algebraic invariants including the Weakest Link bound.

entry.title: Multi-objective Reinforcement Learning With Augmented States Requires Rewards After Deployment

author.name: Peter Vamplew and Cameron Foale

entry.summary: Identifies that multi-objective RL with non-linear utility functions and augmented states requires continued access to the reward signal after deployment, a previously unreported implication that has practical consequences.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Scalable Resilience in UAV Swarms: A Decentralized Imitation Learning Framework with Physics-Informed Graph Interactions

author.name: Huan Lin, Lianghui Ding

entry.summary: PhyGAIL proposes physics-informed graph adversarial imitation learning for UAV swarm recovery after network fragmentation, enabling zero-shot scalability to different swarm sizes and damage severities.

entry.title: Stein Variational Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Thomas Landais, Olivier Goudet, Adrien Go\"effon, Fr\'ed\'eric Saubion and Sylvain Lamprier

entry.summary: Incorporates a Stein operator into Estimation-of-Distribution Algorithms to create a repulsive mechanism among particles, encouraging exploration of multiple optima in high-dimensional combinatorial black-box optimization.

entry.title: Robust Multispectral Semantic Segmentation under Missing or Full Modalities via Structured Latent Projection

author.name: Irem Ulku, Erdem Akag\"und\"uz, \"Omer \"Ozg\"ur Tanr{\i}\"over

entry.summary: Proposes CBC-SLP for multimodal remote sensing segmentation that preserves both modality-invariant and modality-specific information, handling cases where some modalities are missing due to sensor failures while maintaining performance when all modalities are available.

entry.title: CLOTH-HUGS: Cloth Aware Human Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Sadia Mubashshira, Nazanin Amini, Kevin Desai

entry.summary: Presents Cloth-HUGS, a Gaussian Splatting framework for clothed human reconstruction that explicitly disentangles body and clothing using separate Gaussian layers with physics-inspired constraints for cloth realism.

entry.title: From Competition to Coopetition: Coopetitive Training-Free Image Editing Based on Text Guidance

author.name: Jinhao Shen, Haoqian Du, Xulu Zhang, Xiao-Yong Wei, Qing Li

entry.summary: Proposes CoEdit, a training-free text-guided image editing framework that transforms the competitive paradigm between editing and reconstruction branches into a cooperative one through coopetitive attention negotiation.

entry.title: Evaluating quality in synthetic data generation for large tabular health datasets

author.name: Jean-Baptiste Escudi\'e and Benjamin Barnes and Stefan Meisegeier and Klaus Kraywinkel and Fabian Prasser and Nils K\"orber

entry.summary: Evaluates seven synthetic data generation models on large health datasets with systematic hyperparameter tuning, proposing a methodology for evaluating fidelity of synthesized joint distributions with domain-specific analysis on German cancer registry data.

entry.title: Combining Convolution and Delay Learning in Recurrent Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: L\'ucio Folly Sanches Zebendo, Eleonora Cicciarella, Michele Rossi

entry.summary: Proposes combining convolution and delay learning in recurrent spiking neural networks, achieving 99% savings in recurrent parameters and 52x faster inference while maintaining accuracy on audio classification.

entry.title: TableSeq: Unified Generation of Structure, Content, and Layout

author.name: Laziz Hamdi, Amine Tamasna, Pascal Boisson, Thierry Paquet

entry.summary: Presents TableSeq, an end-to-end framework that jointly handles table structure recognition, content recognition, and cell localization as a single sequence-generation problem without external OCR or multi-stage post-processing.

entry.title: Motion-Adapter: A Diffusion Model Adapter for Text-to-Motion Generation of Compound Actions

author.name: Yue Jiang, Mingyu Yang, Liuyuxin Yang, Yang Xu, Bingxin Yun and Yuhe Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Motion-Adapter for text-to-motion diffusion models addressing compound action synthesis. Identifies catastrophic neglect and attention collapse problems, and proposes adapter-based solutions without needing large LLMs or explicit body-part specifications.

entry.title: OT on the Map: Quantifying Domain Shifts in Geographic Space

author.name: Haoran Zhang, Livia Betti, Konstantin Klemmer, Esther Rolf, David Alvarez-Melis

entry.summary: Proposes GeoSpOT, using optimal transport to compute distances between geospatial data distributions, enabling principled assessment of cross-region model transfer feasibility in geographic computer vision.

entry.title: Stop AI

author.name: David Scott Krueger (formerly: capybaralet)

entry.summary: David Krueger outlines arguments for stopping AI development, covering risks from superhuman AI, concentration of power, economic disruption, and the inadequacy of current governance approaches. Argues the precautionary principle should apply given the stakes.

entry.title: Spurious Predictability in Financial Machine Learning

author.name: Sotirios D. Nikolopoulos

entry.summary: Introduces a falsification audit framework to detect spurious predictability in financial ML backtests, testing workflows against synthetic zero-predictability environments. Demonstrates that many apparent financial ML findings are artifacts of adaptive specification search.

entry.title: Generalization Bounds for Quantum Learning via R\'enyi Divergences

author.name: Naqueeb Ahmad Warsi, Ayanava Dasgupta, Masahito Hayashi

entry.summary: Establishes generalization bounds for quantum learning algorithms using Rényi divergences, introducing a modified sandwich quantum Rényi divergence that provides tighter bounds than the Petz divergence.

entry.title: To LLM, or Not to LLM: How Designers and Developers Navigate LLMs as Tools or Teammates

author.name: Varad Vishwarupe, Ivan Flechais, Nigel Shadbolt, Marina Jirotka

entry.summary: Grounded theory study with 33 designers/developers at three large tech organizations examining how they decide whether to use LLMs as tools vs teammates. Finds that role framing determines acceptability more than raw capability.

entry.title: Dispatch-Aware Ragged Attention for Pruned Vision Transformers

author.name: Saif Mahmoud, Ahmad Almasri

entry.summary: Identifies a dispatch-overhead bottleneck in token-pruned Vision Transformers where attention kernels complete in microseconds but host dispatch takes 60-90μs. Presents a Triton kernel with 40μs dispatch floor.

entry.title: Transfer Learning from Foundational Optimization Embeddings to Unsupervised SAT Representations

author.name: Koyena Pal, Serdar Kadioglu

entry.summary: Investigates whether foundational optimization embeddings pre-trained on MIP problems can transfer to Boolean satisfiability (SAT) problems without architectural changes or fine-tuning, by mapping CNF formulas into bipartite constraint-variable graphs.

entry.title: Trajectory Planning for Safe Dual Control with Active Exploration

author.name: Kaleb Ben Naveed, Manveer Singh, Devansh R. Agrawal, Dimitra Panagou

entry.summary: Studies budget-constrained dual control for trajectory planning that formally determines when active exploration is beneficial for uncertainty reduction while maintaining safety and mission-level cost constraints.

entry.title: Preregistered Belief Revision Contracts

author.name: Saad Alqithami

entry.summary: PBRC introduces preregistered belief revision contracts for multi-agent systems that separate communication from epistemic change, preventing conformity effects and false convergence by requiring external evidence for belief updates.

entry.title: CSLE: A Reinforcement Learning Platform for Autonomous Security Management

author.name: Kim Hammar

entry.summary: CSLE is a reinforcement learning platform for autonomous security management that bridges simulation and real systems through emulation, enabling realistic experimentation for security policies in networked systems.

entry.title: BioHiCL: Hierarchical Multi-Label Contrastive Learning for Biomedical Retrieval with MeSH Labels

author.name: Mengfei Lan, Lecheng Zheng, Halil Kilicoglu

entry.summary: BioHiCL leverages hierarchical MeSH annotations for structured supervision in biomedical retrieval through multi-label contrastive learning, achieving promising results while remaining computationally efficient.

entry.title: Causal Bootstrapped Alignment for Unsupervised Video-Based Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification

author.name: Shuang Li, Jiaxu Leng, Changjiang Kuang, Mingpi Tan, Yu Yuan, Xinbo Gao

entry.summary: Introduces unsupervised learning for video-based visible-infrared person re-identification without cross-modality annotations, using causal bootstrapped alignment to handle identity confusion and clustering granularity imbalance.

entry.title: HYPERHEURIST: A Simulated Annealing-Based Control Framework for LLM-Driven Code Generation in Optimized Hardware Design

author.name: Shiva Ahir, Prajna Bhat, Alex Doboli

entry.summary: HYPERHEURIST uses simulated annealing to control LLM-generated RTL hardware designs, treating them as intermediate candidates and optimizing for functionality correctness and power-performance-area metrics.

entry.title: From Zero to Detail: A Progressive Spectral Decoupling Paradigm for UHD Image Restoration with New Benchmark

author.name: Chen Zhao, Yunzhe Xu, Zhizhou Chen, Enxuan Gu, Kai Zhang, Xiaoming Liu, Jian Yang, and Ying Tai

entry.summary: Introduces ERR framework for UHD image restoration using progressive spectral decomposition into zero-frequency enhancement, low-frequency restoration, and high-frequency refinement stages. Also presents a new UHD benchmark dataset.

entry.title: HyCal: A Training-Free Prototype Calibration Method for Cross-Discipline Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Eunju Lee, MiHyeon Kim, JuneHyoung Kwon, Yoonji Lee, JiHyun Kim, Soojin Jang, YoungBin Kim

entry.summary: HyCal identifies 'Domain Gravity' in few-shot class-incremental learning with VLMs where data imbalance causes overrepresented domains to disproportionately influence embeddings. Proposes a training-free prototype calibration method for cross-discipline settings.

entry.title: Why Colors Make Clustering Harder:Global Integrality Gaps, the Price of Fairness, and Color-Coupled Algorithms in Chromatic Correlation Clustering

author.name: Ibne Farabi Shihab, Sanjeda Akter, Anuj Sharma

entry.summary: Proves that Chromatic Correlation Clustering has fundamental integrality gaps beyond standard CC due to cross-edge chromatic interference, and provides a Global Integrality Gap Decomposition Theorem along with improved approximation algorithms.

entry.title: TTL: Test-time Textual Learning for OOD Detection with Pretrained Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jinlun Ye, Jiang Liao, Runhe Lai, Xinhua Lu, Jiaxin Zhuang, Zhiyong Gan, Ruixuan Wang

entry.summary: TTL introduces test-time textual learning for OOD detection with CLIP, dynamically learning OOD textual semantics from unlabeled test streams without relying on fixed external OOD labels.

entry.title: PIIBench: A Unified Multi-Source Benchmark Corpus for Personally Identifiable Information Detection

author.name: Pritesh Jha

entry.summary: PIIBench consolidates 10 PII detection datasets into a unified benchmark with 2.37M annotated sequences and 48 canonical entity types, providing standardized BIO tagging and systematic evaluation of detection approaches.

entry.title: Fed3D: Federated 3D Object Detection

author.name: Suyan Dai, Chenxi Liu, Fazeng Li, Peican Lin

entry.summary: Fed3D proposes the first federated learning framework for 3D object detection addressing privacy concerns in multi-robot perception networks, handling 3D data heterogeneity and limited communication bandwidth.

entry.title: Splats in Splats++: Robust and Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting Steganography

author.name: Yijia Guo, Wenkai Huang, Tong Hu, Gaolei Li, Yang Li, Yuxin Hong, Liwen Hu, Xitong Ling, Jianhua Li, Shengbo Chen, Tiejun Huang, Lei Ma

entry.summary: Presents Splats in Splats++, a steganography framework for embedding high-capacity 3D/4D content within 3D Gaussian Splatting representations, enabling copyright protection of 3DGS assets while maintaining rendering quality.

entry.title: MUSCAT: MUltilingual, SCientific ConversATion Benchmark

author.name: Supriti Sinhamahapatra, Thai-Binh Nguyen, Yi\u{g}it O\u{g}uz, Enes Ugan, Jan Niehues, Alexander Waibel

entry.summary: Introduces MUSCAT, a benchmark for evaluating ASR systems on bilingual scientific discussions with code-switching between speakers using different languages, going beyond standard WER evaluation.

entry.title: From Vulnerable Data Subjects to Vulnerabilizing Data Practices: Navigating the Protection Paradox in AI-Based Analyses of Platformized Lives

author.name: Delfina S. Martinez Pandiani, Ella Streefkerk, Laurens Naudts, Paula Helm

entry.summary: Traces a conceptual shift from understanding data subject vulnerability as a static property to examining how data practices actively create vulnerability, arguing through an AI4SG case study about the ethics of operating on abundant platformized data.

entry.title: AST: Adaptive, Seamless, and Training-Free Precise Speech Editing

author.name: Sihan Lv, Yechen Jin, Zhen Li, Jintao Chen, Jinshan Zhang, Ying Li, Jianwei Yin, Meng Xi

entry.summary: Proposes AST, a training-free speech editing framework using pre-trained autoregressive TTS models. Introduces Latent Recomposition for seamless stitching of preserved and synthesized speech segments, with Diffusion-Refined Melding for boundary smoothing.

entry.title: Unveiling Stochasticity: Universal Multi-modal Probabilistic Modeling for Traffic Forecasting

author.name: Weijiang Xiong, Robert Fonod, Nikolas Geroliminis

entry.summary: Proposes a universal approach to convert deterministic traffic forecasting models into probabilistic predictors by replacing the output layer with a Gaussian Mixture Model layer, requiring no architecture or training pipeline changes.

entry.title: Towards In-Context Tone Style Transfer with A Large-Scale Triplet Dataset

author.name: Yuhai Deng, Huimin She, Wei Shen, Meng Li, Ruoxi Wu, Lunxi Yuan, and Xiang Li

entry.summary: Builds TST100K, a large-scale dataset of 100,000 triplets for tone style transfer, and proposes a method using tone style scoring for quality control and in-context learning with content-reference attention for improved style transfer.

entry.title: Training Time Prediction for Mixed Precision-based Distributed Training

author.name: Minchul Kang, Changyong Shin, Jinwoo Jeong, Hyunho Lee, Younghun Go, Gyeongmin Kim, Gyeongsik Yang, Chuck Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes a precision-aware distributed training time predictor that accounts for floating-point precision settings including mixed precision, reducing prediction error from 147.85% MAPE to robust accuracy across diverse configurations.

entry.title: Optimizing Korean-Centric LLMs via Token Pruning

author.name: Hoyeol Kim and Hyeonwoo Kim

entry.summary: Benchmarks multilingual LLMs (Qwen3, Gemma-3, Llama-3, Aya) under token pruning for Korean-centric NLP. Finds pruning improves generation stability by eliminating language confusion and can enhance machine translation for models with redundant multilingual vocabularies.

entry.title: Geometric regularization of autoencoders via observed stochastic dynamics

author.name: Sean Hill, Felix X.-F. Ye

entry.summary: Introduces geometric regularization penalties for autoencoders learning reduced representations of stochastic dynamical systems. The key insight is that ambient covariance already encodes tangent-space information, enabling tangent-bundle and inverse-consistency penalties that improve learned drift and diffusion estimates. Addresses a long-standing problem in dimensionality reduction for metastable dynamical systems.

entry.title: PRIM-cipal components analysis

author.name: Tianhao Liu and Daniel Andr\'es D\'iaz-Pach\'on and J. Sunil Rao

entry.summary: Proves an unsupervised No Free Lunch Theorem for elliptical distributions showing two opposite bump-hunting strategies (using largest vs smallest principal components) are equally optimal. Proposes PRIM-based algorithms motivated by these theoretical results.

entry.title: Zoom Consistency: A Free Confidence Signal in Multi-Step Visual Grounding Pipelines

author.name: Keon Kim, Krish Chelikavada

entry.summary: Introduces 'zoom consistency' as a free confidence signal in multi-step visual grounding pipelines, measuring distance between model predictions across zoom steps. Proves it's a linear estimator of spatial error under idealized conditions.

entry.title: Lossless Compression via Chained Lightweight Neural Predictors with Information Inheritance

author.name: Yuriy Kim, Evgeny Belyaev

entry.summary: Proposes a lossless compression architecture using chained lightweight neural predictors with an information inheritance mechanism, minimizing total weights while adapting to data's statistical properties for efficient probability estimation.

entry.title: Safe and Energy-Aware Multi-Robot Density Control via PDE-Constrained Optimization for Long-Duration Autonomy

author.name: Longchen Niu, Andrew Nasif, Gennaro Notomista

entry.summary: Presents a density control framework for multi-robot systems integrating Fokker-Planck PDE with control Lyapunov and barrier functions for safety, energy sustainability, and target density tracking.

entry.title: Verification Modulo Tested Library Contracts

author.name: Abhishek Uppar, Omar Muhammad, Sumanth Prabhu, Deepak D'Souza, Madhusudan P, Adithya Murali

entry.summary: Addresses verification of client programs using complex libraries by synthesizing modular contracts that prove client correctness while passing library testing, introducing contextual contracts that hold in the client's context.

entry.title: LLM attribution analysis across different fine-tuning strategies and model scales for automated code compliance

author.name: Jack Wei Lun Shi, Minghao Dang, Wawan Solihin, Justin K.W. Yeoh

entry.summary: Analyzes how different fine-tuning strategies (FFT, LoRA, QLoRA) and model scales affect LLM interpretive behaviors through perturbation-based attribution analysis for automated code compliance.

entry.title: Flexible Empowerment at Reasoning with Extended Best-of-N Sampling

author.name: Taisuke Kobayashi

entry.summary: Proposes using extended best-of-N sampling with empowerment for flexible exploration-exploitation balance in RL, allowing implicit policy modification without explicit learning of exploration bonuses.

entry.title: SIMMER: Cross-Modal Food Image--Recipe Retrieval via MLLM-Based Embedding

author.name: Keisuke Gomi and Keiji Yanai

entry.summary: SIMMER replaces conventional dual-encoder food image-recipe retrieval with a single unified MLLM-based embedding model (VLM2Vec) that processes both modalities, simplifying architecture while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Towards Realistic Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation: Benchmark and Baseline

author.name: Bingyu Li, Tao Huo, Haocheng Dong, Da Zhang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Junyu Gao, and Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Proposes OVRSISBenchV2, a large-scale benchmark for open-vocabulary remote sensing image segmentation with 170K images and 128 categories. Introduces OVRSIS95K dataset and a new baseline model RSProSeg with multi-scale adaptation.

entry.title: Neuromorphic Parameter Estimation for Power Converter Health Monitoring Using Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Hyeongmeen Baik, Hamed Poursiami, Maryam Parsa, Jinia Roy

entry.summary: Proposes neuromorphic parameter estimation for power converter health monitoring using spiking neural networks with physics-informed training. Achieves sub-mW inference with a 270x energy reduction projection on neuromorphic hardware.

entry.title: cuNNQS-SCI: A Fully GPU-Accelerated Framework for High-Performance Configuration Interaction Selection withNeural Network QQantum States

author.name: Daran Sun, Bowen Kan, Haoquan Long, Hairui Zhao, Haoxu Li, Yicheng Liu, Pengyu Zhou, Ankang Feng, Wenjing Huang, Yida Gu, Zhenyu Li, Honghui Shang, Yunquan Zhang, Dingwen Tao, Ninghui Sun, Guangming Tan

entry.summary: cuNNQS-SCI is a fully GPU-accelerated framework for neural network quantum state selected configuration interaction, overcoming scalability barriers of the previous hybrid CPU-GPU architecture through GPU-based de-duplication and configuration generation.

entry.title: CHOP: Chunkwise Context-Preserving Framework for RAG on Multi Documents

author.name: Hyunseok Park, Jihyeon Kim, Jongeun Kim, and Dongsik Yoon

entry.summary: CHOP proposes a RAG framework that iteratively evaluates chunk relevance with LLMs and reconstructs documents by determining chunk associations with topics. Uses per-chunk signatures and continuity decisions to preserve context.

entry.title: SSFT: A Lightweight Spectral-Spatial Fusion Transformer for Generic Hyperspectral Classification

author.name: Alexander Musiat, Nikolas Ebert, Oliver Wasenm\"uller

entry.summary: Proposes SSFT, a lightweight transformer for hyperspectral image classification that factorizes learning into spectral and spatial pathways integrated via cross-attention. Evaluated on a heterogeneous multi-dataset benchmark beyond just earth observation.

entry.title: AHS: Adaptive Head Synthesis via Synthetic Data Augmentations

author.name: Taewoong Kang, Hyojin Jang, Sohyun Jeong, Seunggi Moon, Gihwi Kim, Hoon Jin Jung and Jaegul choo

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Head Synthesis (AHS) for head swapping that handles full upper-body images with varied poses and expressions, using a novel head reenacted synthetic data augmentation strategy to overcome self-supervised training limitations.

entry.title: Environment-Adaptive Solid-State LiDAR-Inertial Odometry

author.name: Zhi Zhang, Chalermchon Satirapod, Bingtao Ma and Changjun Gu

entry.summary: Proposes an environment-adaptive solid-state LiDAR-inertial odometry using local normal-vector constraints and degeneracy-aware map maintenance for accurate mapping in extreme environments with geometric degeneracy.

entry.title: A Reconfigurable Pneumatic Joint Enabling Localized Selective Stiffening and Shape Locking in Vine-Inspired Robots

author.name: Ayodele James Oyejide, Ustaz A. Yaqub, Samir Erturk, Eray A. Baran, Fabio Stroppa

entry.summary: Proposes reconfigurable pneumatic joints for vine-inspired soft growing robots, enabling localized selective stiffening and shape locking without compromising continuous tip eversion growth.

entry.title: SCHK-HTC: Sibling Contrastive Learning with Hierarchical Knowledge-Aware Prompt Tuning for Hierarchical Text Classification

author.name: Ke Xiong and Qian Wu and Wangjie Gan and Yuke Li and Xuhong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SCHK-HTC for few-shot hierarchical text classification using sibling contrastive learning and knowledge-aware prompt tuning to distinguish semantically similar sibling classes in label hierarchies.

entry.title: Polyglot: Multilingual Style Preserving Speech-Driven Facial Animation

author.name: Federico Nocentini, Kwanggyoon Seo, Qingju Liu, Claudio Ferrari, Stefano Berretti, David Ferman, Hyeongwoo Kim, Pablo Garrido, and Akin Caliskan

entry.summary: Introduces Polyglot, a diffusion-based architecture for multilingual speech-driven facial animation that handles both language-specific and speaker-specific conditioning simultaneously, enabling personalized animations across languages.

entry.title: From Articles to Canopies: Knowledge-Driven Pseudo-Labelling for Tree Species Classification using LLM Experts

author.name: Micha{\l} Romaszewski, Dominik Kope\'c, Micha{\l} Cholewa, Katarzyna Ko{\l}odziej, Przemys{\l}aw G{\l}omb, Jan Niedzielko, Jakub Charyton, Justyna Wylaz{\l}owska, Anna Jaroci\'nska

entry.summary: Presents a biologically-informed semi-supervised method for tree species classification from hyperspectral and LiDAR data, using LLMs as expert knowledge sources for pseudo-labeling based on ecological characteristics.

entry.title: Can LLMs Understand the Impact of Trauma? Costs and Benefits of LLMs Coding the Interviews of Firearm Violence Survivors

author.name: Jessica H. Zhu, Shayla Stringfield, Vahe Zaprosyan, Michael Wagner, Michel Cukier, Joseph B. Richardson Jr

entry.summary: Assesses open-source LLMs for coding interviews with Black male firearm violence survivors, evaluating whether AI can ethically and accurately capture vulnerable populations' experiences through thematic analysis.

entry.title: Winner of CVPR2026 NTIRE Challenge on Image Shadow Removal: Semantic and Geometric Guidance for Shadow Removal via Cascaded Refinement

author.name: Lorenzo Beltrame, Jules Salzinger, Filip Svoboda, Jasmin Lampert, Phillipp Fanta-Jende, Radu Timofte, Marco Koerner

entry.summary: Winner of CVPR2026 NTIRE shadow removal challenge. Presents a three-stage progressive pipeline using DINOv2 semantic guidance, monocular depth, and surface normals with contraction-constrained objectives.

entry.title: AIFIND: Artifact-Aware Interpreting Fine-Grained Alignment for Incremental Face Forgery Detection

author.name: Hao Wang, Beichen Zhang, Yanpei Gong, Shaoyi Fang, Zhaobo Qi, Yuanrong Xu, Xinyan Liu, Weigang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes AIFIND for incremental face forgery detection using artifact-driven semantic anchors to stabilize learning across emerging forgery types, addressing feature drift and catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Where Do Vision-Language Models Fail? World Scale Analysis for Image Geolocalization

author.name: Siddhant Bharadwaj, Ashish Vashist, Fahimul Aleem, Shruti Vyas

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates VLMs for country-level image geolocalization in zero-shot settings across three diverse datasets, revealing substantial geographic biases and performance gaps compared to specialized methods.

entry.title: No Universal Courtesy: A Cross-Linguistic, Multi-Model Study of Politeness Effects on LLMs Using the PLUM Corpus

author.name: Hitesh Mehta, Arjit Saxena, Garima Chhikara, Rohit Kumar

entry.summary: Studies how prompt politeness affects LLM responses across three languages, five models, and three interaction histories using an eight-factor assessment framework on 22,500 prompt-response pairs.

entry.title: Repurposing 3D Generative Model for Autoregressive Layout Generation

author.name: Haoran Feng, Yifan Niu, Zehuan Huang, Yang-Tian Sun, Chunchao Guo, Yuxin Peng, Lu Sheng

entry.summary: Presents LaviGen, which repurposes 3D generative models for autoregressive 3D layout generation, operating directly in 3D space rather than inferring from text. Uses a dual-guidance self-rollout distillation mechanism and achieves 19% higher physical plausibility on the LayoutVLM benchmark.

entry.title: NK-GAD: Neighbor Knowledge-Enhanced Unsupervised Graph Anomaly Detection

author.name: Zehao Wang and Lanjun Wang

entry.summary: NK-GAD proposes a graph anomaly detection method that works with attribute-level heterophily graphs by incorporating neighbor knowledge. Addresses limitations of existing methods that assume homophily between connected nodes.

entry.title: PLAF: Pixel-wise Language-Aligned Feature Extraction for Efficient 3D Scene Understanding

author.name: Junjie Wen, Junlin He, Fei Ma, Jinqiang Cui

entry.summary: PLAF proposes pixel-wise language-aligned feature extraction for efficient 3D scene understanding, enabling dense semantic alignment in 2D with an efficient storage and querying scheme for large-scale 3D scenes.

entry.title: Factor Graph-Based Shape Estimation for Continuum Robots via Magnus Expansion

author.name: Lorenzo Ticozzi, Patricio A. Vela and Panagiotis Tsiotras

entry.summary: Combines geometric variable strain parameterization with factor graphs for continuum robot shape estimation, using Magnus expansion to derive kinematic factors that encode rod geometry as priors.

entry.title: APC: Transferable and Efficient Adversarial Point Counterattack for Robust 3D Point Cloud Recognition

author.name: Geunyoung Jung, Soohong Kim, Inseok Kong, Jiyoung Jung

entry.summary: APC proposes adversarial point counterattack, a lightweight purification module that generates instance-specific counter-perturbations for 3D point clouds to neutralize adversarial attacks while maintaining transferability across attack types.

entry.title: MambaBack: Bridging Local Features and Global Contexts in Whole Slide Image Analysis

author.name: Sicheng Chen, Chad Wong, Tianyi Zhang, Enhui Chai, Zeyu Liu, Fei Xia

entry.summary: MambaBack addresses three challenges in Mamba-based whole slide image analysis: disrupted 2D spatial locality, inadequate local structure modeling, and high memory during inference. Proposes solutions bridging local features and global contexts.

entry.title: Stylistic-STORM (ST-STORM) : Perceiving the Semantic Nature of Appearance

author.name: Hamed Ouattara, Pierre Duthon, Pascal Houssam Salmane, Fr\'ed\'eric Bernardin, Omar Ait Aider

entry.summary: Proposes ST-STORM for self-supervised learning that preserves appearance-related features (weather conditions, visibility) rather than being invariant to them, specifically for weather analysis and autonomous driving applications.

entry.title: Toxic Memes: A Survey of Computational Perspectives on the Detection and Explanation of Meme Toxicities

author.name: Delfina Sol Martinez Pandiani, Erik Tjong Kim Sang, Davide Ceolin

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of computational approaches to toxic meme detection and explanation, covering 158 works and 30+ datasets through early 2024. Uses PRISMA methodology to systematically organize the field.

entry.title: Technically Love: The Evolution of Human-AI Romance Discourse on Reddit

author.name: Tyler Chang, Jina Huh-Yoo, Afsaneh Razi

entry.summary: Analyzes longitudinal evolution of human-AI romance discourse on Reddit (2017-2025) using 3,383 posts. Finds significant topic drift from positive relationships toward platform governance, technical issues, and real-world consequences.

entry.title: Photonic AI: A Hybrid Diffractive Holographic Neural System for Passive Optical Real-Time Image Classification

author.name: Prakul Sunil Hiremath

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid diffractive holographic neural architecture for passive optical image classification, coupling Diffractive Optical Neural Networks with holographic interference-based learning for edge intelligence.

entry.title: M3R: Localized Rainfall Nowcasting with Meteorology-Informed MultiModal Attention

author.name: Sanjeev Panta, Rhett M Morvant, Xu Yuan, Li Chen, Nian-Feng Tzeng

entry.summary: Introduces M3R, a meteorology-informed multimodal architecture for rainfall nowcasting that combines NEXRAD radar imagery with weather station measurements using specialized cross-modal attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Exploring LLM-based Verilog Code Generation with Data-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Testbench Automation

author.name: Mu-Chi Chen, Po-Hsuan Huang, Yu-Hung Kao, Yen-Fu Liu, Yu-Kai Hung, Cheng Liang, Shao-Chun Ho, Chia-Heng Tu and Shih-Hao Hung

entry.summary: Presents a workflow using multi-agent LLMs to generate testbenches for Verilog fine-tuning data, achieving comparable performance to state-of-the-art on VerilogEval v2 with less training data.

entry.title: Analyzing Chain of Thought (CoT) Approaches in Control Flow Code Deobfuscation Tasks

author.name: Seyedreza Mohseni, Sarvesh Baskar, Edward Raff, Manas Gaur

entry.summary: Explores using Chain-of-Thought prompting for code deobfuscation, evaluating five LLMs on control flow obfuscation techniques. Shows CoT significantly improves deobfuscation quality over standard prompting.

entry.title: Iterated Invariant EKF for Quadruped Robot Odometry

author.name: Hilton Marques Souza Santana, Jo\~ao Carlos Virgolino Soares, Sven Goffin, Ylenia Nistic\`o, Silv\`ere Bonnabel, Claudio Semini, Marco Antonio Meggiolaro

entry.summary: Proposes an Iterated Invariant Extended Kalman Filter for quadruped robot odometry, extending both system dynamics and measurement model assumptions to nonlinear Lie group settings, improving state estimation accuracy.

entry.title: The Crutch or the Ceiling? How Different Generations of LLMs Shape EFL Student Writings

author.name: Hengky Susanto, David James Woo, Chingyi Yeung, Stephanie Wing Yan Lo-Philip, Chi Ho Yeung

entry.summary: Studies how different generations of LLMs impact EFL student writing, finding that advanced LLMs boost scores and lexical diversity but may reduce students' deeper linguistic engagement, raising concerns about LLMs as 'crutches' rather than 'scaffolds'.

entry.title: Consistency Analysis of Sentiment Predictions using Syntactic & Semantic Context Assessment Summarization (SSAS)

author.name: Sharookh Daruwalla, Nitin Mayande, Shreeya Verma Kathuria, Nitin Joglekar, Charles Weber

entry.summary: SSAS framework establishes syntactic and semantic context as a preprocessing step for LLM sentiment analysis, enforcing bounded attention to improve prediction consistency for enterprise applications.

entry.title: Learning Behaviorally Grounded Item Embeddings via Personalized Temporal Contexts

author.name: Rafael T. Sereicikas and Pedro R. Pires and Gregorio F. Azevedo and Tiago A. Almeida

entry.summary: TAI2Vec introduces time-aware item embeddings that integrate temporal proximity into representation learning, distinguishing between short-term sessions and long-term interest drifts for better user modeling in recommender systems.

entry.title: VoodooNet: Achieving Analytic Ground States via High-Dimensional Random Projections

author.name: Wladimir Silva

entry.summary: VoodooNet replaces SGD with a closed-form solution via high-dimensional random projection, achieving 98.1% on MNIST and 86.6% on Fashion-MNIST in a single step without backpropagation.

entry.title: PINNACLE: An Open-Source Computational Framework for Classical and Quantum PINNs

author.name: Shimon Pisnoy, Hemanth Chandravamsi, Ziv Chen, Aaron Goldgewert, Gal Shaviner, Boris Shragner, Steven H. Frankel

entry.summary: PINNACLE is an open-source framework for physics-informed neural networks that integrates modern training strategies, multi-GPU acceleration, and hybrid quantum-classical architectures. It provides comprehensive benchmarks across various physics problems including conservation laws and electromagnetic wave propagation.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Angular Deblurring in Photoacoustic Reconstruction via Noisier2Inverse

author.name: Markus Haltmeier, Nadja Gruber, Gyeongha Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised method for photoacoustic tomography reconstruction that compensates for finite-detector angular blurring without requiring ground-truth images, using a Noisier2Inverse-style approach.

entry.title: SSMamba: A Self-Supervised Hybrid State Space Model for Pathological Image Classification

author.name: Enhui Chai, Sicheng Chen, Tianyi Zhang, Xingyu Li, Tianxiang Cui

entry.summary: SSMamba combines Mamba state space models with self-supervised learning for pathological image classification, addressing cross-magnification domain shift and local-global feature modeling in whole-slide images.

entry.title: Concept-wise Attention for Fine-grained Concept Bottleneck Models

author.name: Minghong Zhong, Guoshuai Zou, Kanghao Chen, Dexia Chen, Ruixuan Wang

entry.summary: CoAt-CBM proposes concept-wise attention for fine-grained concept bottleneck models, addressing pre-training biases and concept mutual exclusivity issues in CLIP-based concept modeling.

entry.title: Fuzzy Logic Theory-based Adaptive Reward Shaping for Robust Reinforcement Learning (FARS)

author.name: H\"urkan \c{S}ahin, Van Huyen Dang, Erdi Sayar, Alper Yegenoglu, and Erdal Kayacan

entry.summary: Proposes fuzzy logic-based adaptive reward shaping for reinforcement learning that encodes expert knowledge into interpretable fuzzy rules, enabling stable learning with reduced hyperparameter sensitivity for drone racing tasks.

entry.title: Watching Movies Like a Human: Egocentric Emotion Understanding for Embodied Companions

author.name: Ze Dong, Hao Shi, Zejia Gao, Zhonghua Yi, Kaiwei Wang, Lin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces EgoScreen-Emotion (ESE), the first benchmark for understanding movie emotions from an egocentric screen-view perspective, addressing domain shifts like viewpoint distortion when robots watch movies through screens rather than native footage.

entry.title: Limits of Lamarckian Evolution Under Pressure of Morphological Novelty

author.name: Jed R Muff, Karine Miras, A.E. Eiben

entry.summary: Studies how Lamarckian inheritance in evolutionary robotics performs when the search is driven toward high morphological variance, testing whether parent-offspring controller inheritance remains beneficial when morphologies diverge significantly.

entry.title: Robust Fleet Sizing for Multi-UAV Inspection Missions under Synchronized Replacement Demand

author.name: Vishal Ramesh and Antony Thomas

entry.summary: Derives a closed-form fleet sizing rule for multi-UAV inspection missions, identifying a structural failure mode where efficient routing causes synchronized battery depletion that exhausts spare drones.

entry.title: AeroDeshadow: Physics-Guided Shadow Synthesis and Penumbra-Aware Deshadowing for Aerospace Imagery

author.name: Wei Lu and Zi-Yang Bo and Fei-Fei Sang and Yi Liu and Xue Yang and Si-Bao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AeroDeshadow, a two-stage framework for shadow removal in aerospace imagery combining physics-guided shadow synthesis for training data generation and penumbra-aware restoration for the broad transition zones specific to aerospace scenes.

entry.title: Topology-Driven Fusion of nnU-Net and MedNeXt for Accurate Brain Tumor Segmentation on Sub-Saharan Africa Dataset

author.name: Prabin Bohara, Pralhad Kumar Shrestha, Arpan Rai, Usha Poudel Lamgade, Confidence Raymond, Dong Zhang, Aondona Lorumbu, Craig Jones, Mahesh Shakya, Bishesh Khanal, and Pratibha Kulung

entry.summary: Applies topology refinement to nnU-Net and MedNeXt for brain tumor segmentation on Sub-Saharan African MRI data, pre-training on BraTS 2025 data then fine-tuning on BraTS-Africa to address low image quality from low-field MRI scanners.

entry.title: IA-CLAHE: Image-Adaptive Clip Limit Estimation for CLAHE

author.name: Rikuto Otsuka, Yuho Shoji, Yuka Ogino, Takahiro Toizumi, Atsushi Ito

entry.summary: Proposes IA-CLAHE, an image-adaptive version of CLAHE that estimates tile-wise clip limits using a lightweight learned estimator, enabled by a differentiable extension of CLAHE for end-to-end training.

entry.title: AstroVLM: Expert Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning for Astronomical Imaging Quality Diagnosis

author.name: Yaohui Han, Tianshuo Wang, Zixi Zhao, Zhengchun Zhu, Shuo Ren, Yiru Wang, Rongliang Fu, Tinghuan Chen, Tsung-Yi Ho

entry.summary: Proposes AstroVLM, a collaborative multi-agent VLM system for diagnosing astronomical image quality, addressing the complex multidisciplinary process where imaging steps have complex correlations affecting quality.

entry.title: Ranking XAI Methods for Head and Neck Cancer Outcome Prediction

author.name: Baoqiang Ma, Djennifer K. Madzia-Madzou, Rosa C.J. Kraaijveld, Jin Ouyang

entry.summary: Comprehensively evaluates and ranks 13 explainable AI methods across 24 metrics for head and neck cancer outcome prediction on PET/CT data. Finds Integrated Gradients and DeepLIFT perform best across faithfulness, robustness, complexity, and plausibility.

entry.title: LLMSniffer: Detecting LLM-Generated Code via GraphCodeBERT and Supervised Contrastive Learning

author.name: Mahir Labib Dihan, Abir Muhtasim

entry.summary: Presents LLMSniffer, a framework for detecting LLM-generated code using GraphCodeBERT with supervised contrastive learning. Achieves improvements over baselines on GPTSniffer and Whodunit benchmarks.

entry.title: Robust Synchronisation for Federated Learning in The Face of Correlated Device Failure

author.name: Stefan Behfar, Richard Mortier

entry.summary: Addresses correlated device failures in federated learning where Probabilistic Synchronous Parallel sampling leads to unfair training when device availability correlates with data distribution. Proposes robust synchronization methods.

entry.title: ChemGraph-XANES: An Agentic Framework for XANES Simulation and Analysis

author.name: Vitor F. Grizzi, Thang Duc Pham, Luke N. Pretzie, Jiayi Xu, Murat Keceli, Cong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces ChemGraph-XANES, an agentic framework using LangGraph/LangChain to automate XANES simulation workflows including structure acquisition, input generation, parallel execution, and data curation via natural language.

entry.title: CollideNet: Hierarchical Multi-scale Video Representation Learning with Disentanglement for Time-To-Collision Forecasting

author.name: Nishq Poorav Desai, Ali Etemad, Michael Greenspan

entry.summary: Introduces CollideNet, a hierarchical multi-scale video representation architecture for Time-to-Collision forecasting that disentangles non-stationarity, trend, and seasonality in the temporal stream.

entry.title: BAGEL: Benchmarking Animal Knowledge Expertise in Language Models

author.name: Jiacheng Shen, Masato Hagiwara, Milad Alizadeh, Ellen Gilsenan-McMahon, Marius Miron, David Robinson, Emmanuel Chemla, Sara Keen, Gagan Narula, Mathieu Lauri\`ere, Matthieu Geist, Olivier Pietquin

entry.summary: Introduces BAGEL, a benchmark for evaluating animal knowledge in LLMs covering taxonomy, morphology, habitat, behavior, vocalization, distribution, and species interactions using closed-book QA from diverse scientific sources.

entry.title: Joint-Centric Dual Contrastive Alignment with Structure-Preserving and Information-Balanced Regularization

author.name: Habibeh Naderi, Behrouz Haji Soleimani, Stan Matwin

entry.summary: Proposes HILBERT, a cross-attentive multimodal framework for document-level audio-text representations using frozen encoders, reciprocal dual contrastive learning, and information-balanced regularization for low-resource settings.

entry.title: FineCog-Nav: Integrating Fine-grained Cognitive Modules for Zero-shot Multimodal UAV Navigation

author.name: Dian Shao, Zhengzheng Xu, Peiyang Wang, Like Liu, Yule Wang, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo

entry.summary: Proposes FineCog-Nav, a cognitive-module-inspired framework for zero-shot UAV vision-language navigation that decomposes navigation into fine-grained modules (language processing, perception, memory, reasoning, etc.). Each module uses a moderate-sized foundation model with role-specific prompts, aiming for better interpretability and performance than monolithic approaches.

entry.title: Graph self-supervised learning based on frequency corruption

author.name: Haojie Li, Mengjiao Zhang, Guanfeng Liu, Qiang Hu, Yan Wang, Junwei Du

entry.summary: FC-GSSL proposes graph self-supervised learning using frequency-domain corruption, creating corrupted graphs biased toward high-frequency information and reconstructing low-frequency features as supervision targets to force multi-frequency fusion.

entry.title: P3T: Prototypical Point-level Prompt Tuning with Enhanced Generalization for 3D Vision-Language Models

author.name: Geunyoung Jung, Soohong Kim, Kyungwoo Song, Jiyoung Jung

entry.summary: P3T proposes parameter-efficient prompt tuning for 3D vision-language models using prototypical point-level prompts and learnable text prompts, addressing overfitting in prompt tuning methods.

entry.title: Diffusion Autoencoder for Unsupervised Artifact Restoration in Handheld Fundus Images

author.name: Mathumetha Palani, Kavya Puthumana, Ayantika Das, Ganapathy Krishnamurthi

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised diffusion autoencoder for artifact restoration in handheld fundus images, integrating a context encoder with denoising to handle unstructured degradations without paired supervision.

entry.title: Sketch and Text Synergy: Fusing Structural Contours and Descriptive Attributes for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval

author.name: Siyuan Wang and Hanchen Gao and Guangming Zhu and Jiang Lu and Yiyue Ma and Tianci Wu and Jincai Huang and Liang Zhang

entry.summary: STBIR combines sketch and text modalities for fine-grained image retrieval, leveraging complementary information (sketches for structural contours, text for color/texture) with curriculum learning and category-knowledge-based feature alignment.

entry.title: SegMix:Shuffle-based Feedback Learning for Semantic Segmentation of Pathology Images

author.name: Zhiling Yan, Sicheng Chen, Tianyi Zhang, Nan Ying, Yanli Lei, Guanglei Zhang

entry.summary: SegMix proposes shuffle-based feedback learning for pathology image segmentation using only image-level labels, improving CAM-based pseudo-annotation quality through exploring essential characteristics of pathology images.

entry.title: Analyzing Shapley Additive Explanations to Understand Anomaly Detection Algorithm Behaviors and Their Complementarity

author.name: Jordan Levy, Paul Saves, Moncef Garouani, Nicolas Verstaevel, Benoit Gaudou

entry.summary: Proposes using SHAP to characterize how different anomaly detectors make decisions, enabling construction of genuinely complementary ensembles rather than redundant combinations.

entry.title: CogEvolution: A Human-like Generative Educational Agent to Simulate Student's Cognitive Evolution

author.name: Wei Zhang, Yihang Cheng, Zhirong Ye, Kezhen Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CogEvolution, an LLM-based educational agent that simulates dynamic cognitive evolution of students, modeling knowledge internalization, transfer, and cognitive state transitions rather than using static personas.

entry.title: Facial-Expression-Aware Prompting for Empathetic LLM Tutoring

author.name: Shuangquan Feng, Laura Fleig, Ruisen Tu, Philip Chi, Edmund Bu, Melinda Ozel, Junhua Ma, Teng Fei, Virginia R. de Sa

entry.summary: Proposes facial-expression-aware prompting for LLM tutoring agents, using Action Units from student facial expressions to generate more empathetic responses without model retraining.

entry.title: VeriCWEty: Embedding enabled Line-Level CWE Detection in Verilog

author.name: Prithwish Basu Roy and Zeng Wang and Anatolii Chuvashlov and Weihua Xiao and Johann Knechtel and Ozgur Sinanoglu and Ramesh Karri

entry.summary: Proposes VeriCWEty, an embedding-based framework for detecting and classifying common weaknesses (CWEs) in Verilog code at module and line-level granularity, achieving ~89% precision for common CWEs.

entry.title: ExoNet: Multimodal Deep Learning for TESS Exoplanet Candidate Identification via Phase-Folded Light Curves, Stellar Parameters, and Multi-Head Attention Fusion

author.name: Md.Rashadul Islam

entry.summary: ExoNet uses multimodal deep learning combining phase-folded light curves with stellar parameters via multi-head attention fusion to classify TESS exoplanet candidates, identifying high-confidence candidates including some in habitable zones.

entry.title: Collaborative Filtering Through Weighted Similarities of User and Item Embeddings

author.name: Pedro R. Pires and Rafael T. Sereicikas and Gregorio F. Azevedo and Tiago A. Almeida

entry.summary: Proposes an ensemble method for collaborative filtering that unifies user-item and item-item recommendations through weighted similarities using shared embeddings, offering simplicity competitive with complex neural methods.

entry.title: FD-NL2SQL: Feedback-Driven Clinical NL2SQL that Improves with Use

author.name: Suparno Roy Chowdhury, Tejas Anvekar, Manan Roy Choudhury, Muhammad Ali Khan, Kaneez Zahra Rubab Khakwani, Mohamad Bassam Sonbol, Irbaz Bin Riaz, Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: FD-NL2SQL is a feedback-driven system that helps clinicians query oncology trial databases using natural language. It decomposes queries, retrieves similar verified examples, and improves over time through clinician edits and logic-based SQL feedback.

entry.title: NeuroLip: An Event-driven Spatiotemporal Learning Framework for Cross-Scene Lip-Motion-based Visual Speaker Recognition

author.name: Junguang Yao, Wenye Liu, Stjepan Picek, Yue Zheng

entry.summary: NeuroLip proposes event-camera-based lip motion recognition for speaker identification, leveraging neuromorphic sensing to capture fine-grained articulation dynamics that frame-based cameras miss due to motion blur.

entry.title: JFinTEB: Japanese Financial Text Embedding Benchmark

author.name: Masahiro Suzuki, Hiroki Sakaji

entry.summary: Introduces JFinTEB, the first comprehensive benchmark for Japanese financial text embeddings, covering retrieval and classification tasks reflecting realistic financial text processing scenarios.

entry.title: GAViD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset for Context-Aware Group Affect Recognition from Videos

author.name: Deepak Kumar, Abhishek Pratap Singh, Puneet Kumar, Xiaobai Li, Balasubramanian Raman

entry.summary: Introduces GAViD, a large-scale multimodal dataset for group affect recognition from videos with contextual annotations covering human-human interactions in complex social environments.

entry.title: Learning to Hear Broken Motors: Signature-Guided Data Augmentation for Induction-Motor Diagnostics

author.name: Saraa Ali, Aleksandr Khizhik, Stepan Svirin, Artem Ryzhikov, Denis Derkach

entry.summary: Introduces Signature-Guided Data Augmentation (SGDA) for induction motor fault diagnosis, combining physics-based Motor Current Signature Analysis with ML to synthesize realistic faults in the frequency domain without labeled fault data.

entry.title: AI-Driven SEEG Channel Ranking for Epileptogenic Zone Localization

author.name: Saeed Hashemi, Genchang Peng, Mehrdad Nourani, Omar Nofal, Jay Harvey

entry.summary: Proposes using XGBoost and SHAP to rank SEEG channels for epileptogenic zone localization, incorporating clinician selections and extending search beyond initially selected channels.

entry.title: Struggle Premium : How Human Effort and Imperfection Drive Perceived Value in the Age of AI

author.name: Nazneen Sultana, Mst Rafia Islam, Md. Tanvir Hossain, Azmine Toushik Wasi

entry.summary: Studies the 'Struggle Premium' - how visible human effort cues influence perceived value of creative works versus AI-generated content. Finds 72.9% of participants willing to pay more for human-made works, with process-oriented cues most impactful.

entry.title: TopFeaRe: Locating Critical State of Adversarial Resilience for Graphs Regarding Topology-Feature Entanglement

author.name: Xinxin Fan, Wenxiong Chen, Quanliang Jing, Chi Lin, Shaoye Luo, Wenbo Song, Yunfeng Lu

entry.summary: Proposes TopFeaRe, an adversarial defense approach for graphs that locates critical states of adversarial resilience using equilibrium-point theory from complex dynamic systems.

entry.title: InfoChess: A Game of Adversarial Inference and a Laboratory for Quantifiable Information Control

author.name: Kieran A. Murphy

entry.summary: Introduces InfoChess, a game where competitive information acquisition is the primary objective (no piece capture). Trains RL agents and analyzes strategies through information-theoretic measures.

entry.title: LLMbench: A Comparative Close Reading Workbench for Large Language Models

author.name: David M. Berry

entry.summary: LLMbench is a browser-based workbench for comparative close reading of LLM outputs, oriented toward digital humanities hermeneutic practices rather than quantitative evaluation, with multiple analytical overlays.

entry.title: UA-Net: Uncertainty-Aware Network for TRISO Image Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Kyle Lucke, Zuzanna Krajewska-Travar, Shoukun Sun, Lu Cai, John D. Stempien, Min Xian

entry.summary: UA-Net segments five characteristic regions of TRISO fuel micrographs and generates uncertainty maps for predictions, using multi-stage pretraining to assist automated analysis of nuclear fuel post-irradiation.

entry.title: Enhancing Discrete Particle Swarm Optimization for Hypergraph-Modeled Influence Maximization

author.name: Qianshi Wang, Xilong Qu, Wenbin Pei, Nan Li, Qiang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a discrete particle swarm optimization method for influence maximization on hypergraphs, better capturing higher-order interactions in real-world networks compared to standard graph-based approaches.

entry.title: Convolutionally Low-Rank Models with Modified Quantile Regression for Interval Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Miaoxuan Zhu, Yi Yu, Yuyang Li, Wei Li, Guangcan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes convolutionally low-rank models with modified quantile regression for interval time series forecasting, adding uncertainty estimation to the LbCNNM framework through prediction intervals.

entry.title: From Intention to Text: AI-Supported Goal Setting in Academic Writing

author.name: Yueling Fan, Richard Lee Davis, Olga Viberg

entry.summary: WriteFlow is an AI voice-based writing assistant supporting reflective academic writing through goal-oriented dialogic interaction. Wizard-of-Oz study shows it scaffolds metacognitive regulation and reflection-in-action.

entry.title: Exploring the Capability Boundaries of LLMs in Mastering of Chinese Chouxiang Language

author.name: Dianqing Lin, Tian Lan, Jiali Zhu, Jiang Li, Wei Chen, Xu Liu, Aruukhan, Xiangdong Su, Hongxu Hou, Guanglai Gao

entry.summary: Introduces Mouse benchmark to evaluate LLMs on Chinese 'Chouxiang Language' (internet subculture language), finding that current SOTA LLMs show clear limitations on most tasks while performing well on contextual semantic understanding tasks.

entry.title: Constant-Factor Approximations for Doubly Constrained Fair k-Center, k-Median and k-Means

author.name: Nicole Funk, Annika Hennes, Johanna Hillebrand and Sarah Sturm

entry.summary: Studies fair k-clustering problems combining group fairness (balanced attribute proportions) and diverse center selection constraints. Provides constant-factor approximation algorithms for k-center, k-median, and k-means under both constraints simultaneously.

entry.title: Univariate Channel Fusion for Multivariate Time Series Classification

author.name: Fernando Moro and Vinicius M. A. Souza

entry.summary: Proposes Univariate Channel Fusion (UCF) that transforms multivariate time series into univariate representations through simple fusion strategies, enabling efficient classification suitable for IoT and wearable systems.

entry.title: Hero-Mamba: Mamba-based Dual Domain Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement

author.name: Tejeswar Pokuri, Shivarth Rai

entry.summary: Proposes Hero-Mamba, a Mamba-based network for underwater image enhancement that processes spatial and spectral (FFT) domains in parallel, achieving efficient dual-domain learning.

entry.title: Using Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs to Improve the Interpretability of Machine Learning Models in Manufacturing

author.name: Thomas Bayer, Alexander Lohr, Sarah Wei{\ss}, Bernd Michelberger, Wolfram H\"opken

entry.summary: Proposes a method combining Knowledge Graphs and LLMs to make ML model explanations more interpretable in manufacturing settings. The KG stores domain knowledge alongside ML results and explanations, and an LLM generates user-friendly natural language from retrieved graph triplets. Evaluated using the XAI Question Bank in a manufacturing environment.

entry.title: Power in Numbers: Primitive Algorithm for Swarm Robot Navigation in Unknown Environments

author.name: Yusuke Tsunoda, Shoken Otsuka, Kazuki Ito, Runze Xiao, Keisuke Naniwa, Yuichiro Sueoka, Koichi Osuka

entry.summary: Proposes a simple swarm robot navigation algorithm for unknown environments that uses robot count rather than complex sensing. Robots navigate without cameras, LiDAR, or reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Holi-DETR: Holistic Fashion Item Detection Leveraging Contextual Information

author.name: Youngchae Kwon, Jinyoung Choi, Injung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Holi-DETR for holistic fashion item detection using contextual information including co-occurrence relationships, relative positioning, and spatial proximity between items in outfit images.

entry.title: MRGEN: A Conceptual Framework for LLM-Powered Mixed Reality Authoring Tools for Education

author.name: Mohammed Oussama Seddini (LIUM), Mohamed Ez-Zaouia (UR, IRISA, DRUID), Ngoc Luyen Le (Heudiasyc), Iza Marfisi (LIUM, IUT Laval)

entry.summary: Proposes MRGEN, a framework for LLM-powered Mixed Reality authoring tools for education. Prototype reduced task duration by 36% and 90%+ of participants found AI support helpful.

entry.title: Taming Asynchronous CPU-GPU Coupling for Frequency-aware Latency Estimation on Mobile Edge

author.name: Jiesong Chen, Jun You, Zhidan Liu, Zhenjiang Li

entry.summary: Addresses frequency-aware latency estimation for model inference on mobile edge devices, tackling the asynchronous CPU-GPU coupling challenge under Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling.

entry.title: Prompt-Driven Code Summarization: A Systematic Literature Review

author.name: Afia Farjana, Zaiyu Cheng, Antonio Mastropaolo

entry.summary: Systematic literature review of prompt-driven code summarization approaches, covering how prompt engineering affects LLM performance in generating natural language descriptions from source code.

entry.title: PAWN: Piece Value Analysis with Neural Networks

author.name: Ethan Tang, Hasan Davulcu, Jia Zou, Zhongju Zhang

entry.summary: PAWN uses CNN-based autoencoders to create latent chess board representations that improve MLP-based piece value prediction, reducing error by 16% on 12M+ piece-value pairs labeled by Stockfish 17.

entry.title: LP$^{2}$DH: A Locality-Preserving Pixel-Difference Hashing Framework for Dynamic Texture Recognition

author.name: Ruxin Ding, Jianfeng Ren, Heng Yu, Jiawei Li, Xudong Jiang

entry.summary: LP²DH proposes a locality-preserving pixel-difference hashing framework for dynamic texture recognition that jointly encodes pixel differences in full spatiotemporal neighborhoods, avoiding the limitations of orthogonal plane extraction.

entry.title: Frenetic Cat-inspired Particle Optimization: a Markov state-switching hybrid swarm optimizer with application to cardiac digital twinning

author.name: Jorge S\'anchez, Guadalupe Garc\'ia-Isla, Sandra Perez-Herrero, Beatriz Trenor, Javier Saiz

entry.summary: FCPO is a hybrid swarm optimizer combining PSO dynamics with Markov switching controllers for expensive black-box optimization, applied to cardiac digital twinning parameter estimation.

entry.title: Dual-Modal Lung Cancer AI: Interpretable Radiology and Microscopy with Clinical Risk Integration

author.name: Baramee Sukumal and Aueaphum Aueawatthanaphisut

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-modal AI framework integrating CT radiology with H&E histopathology for lung cancer diagnosis, using weighted decision-level fusion of CNNs with clinical metadata to classify adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and normal tissue.

entry.title: From Benchmarking to Reasoning: A Dual-Aspect, Large-Scale Evaluation of LLMs on Vietnamese Legal Text

author.name: Van-Truong Le

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs for Vietnamese legal text simplification using a dual-aspect framework: performance benchmarking of four models and large-scale error analysis on 60 complex legal articles with expert validation.

entry.title: Summarizing and Reviewing my earliest ML research paper, 7 years later

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: Retrospective review of the author's earliest ML paper 'The Assistive Multi-Armed Bandit,' which formalized how preference learning fails when humans are still learning their own preferences. The paper modeled human-robot interaction where a robot assists a human who doesn't yet know their reward function.

entry.title: Stitching Gaps: Fusing Situated Perceptual Knowledge with Vision Transformers for High-Level Image Classification

author.name: Delfina Sol Martinez Pandiani, Nicolas Lazzari, Valentina Presutti

entry.summary: Proposes fusing situated perceptual knowledge from a knowledge graph with Vision Transformers for abstract concept classification in cultural images. Builds the ARTstract Knowledge Graph from 14,000+ cultural images.

entry.title: Tendon-driven Grasper Design for Aerial Robot Perching on Tree Branches

author.name: Haichuan Li, Ziang Zhao, Ziniu Wu, Parth Potdar, Long Tran, Ali Tahir Karasahin, Shane Windsor, Stephen G. Burrow, Basaran Bahadir Kocer

entry.summary: Designs a bio-inspired tendon-driven grasper for aerial robots to perch on tree branches for forest ecosystem data collection. Uses raptor-inspired vision for branch detection and bat claw-inspired passive mechanism.

entry.title: Modeling of ASD/TD Children's Behaviors in Interaction with a Virtual Social Robot During a Music Education Program Using Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Armin Tandiseh, Morteza Memari, Alireza Taheri

entry.summary: Develops a deep learning system to classify ASD vs neurotypical children based on behaviors during interaction with a virtual social robot in music education, achieving 88.39% classification accuracy.

entry.title: Explainable Iterative Data Visualisation Refinement via an LLM Agent

author.name: Burak Susam, Tingting Mu

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based agentic pipeline for iteratively refining high-dimensional data visualizations by bridging quantitative evaluation metrics with qualitative human insight for hyperparameter optimization.

entry.title: Automating Crash Diagram Generation Using Vision-Language Models: A Case Study on Multi-Lane Roundabouts

author.name: Xiao Lu, Hao Zhen, Jidong J. Yang

entry.summary: Investigates using Vision-Language Models to automate crash diagram generation from police reports, testing GPT-4o, Gemini-1.5-Flash, and Janus-4o on 79 crash reports with a 10-metric evaluation system.

entry.title: SocialWise: LLM-Agentic Conversation Therapy for Individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder to Enhance Communication Skills

author.name: Albert Tang

entry.summary: Introduces SocialWise, a browser-based LLM conversation therapy application for people with ASD to practice everyday conversations using RAG-augmented agents with scenario-based roleplay.

entry.title: Mapping High-Performance Regions in Battery Scheduling across Data Uncertainty, Battery Design, and Planning Horizons

author.name: Jaime de Miguel Rodriguez, Artjom Vargunin, Brigitta Robin Raudne, David Solis Martin, Yaroslava Mykhailenko, Kaarel Oja

entry.summary: Analyzes battery scheduling under model predictive control, investigating the interplay between forecast uncertainty, planning horizon, and battery c-rate. Identifies 'effective horizons' beyond which additional forecast information provides limited benefit.

entry.title: A Q-learning-based QoS-aware multipath routing protocol in IoMT-based wireless body area network

author.name: Mehdi Hosseinzadeh, Roohallah Alizadehsani, Amin Beheshti, Hamid Alinejad-Roknyd, Lu Chen, Mohammad Sadegh Yousefpoor, Efat Yousefpoor, Muneera Altayeb, Thantrira Porntaveetus, Sadia Din

entry.summary: Proposes a Q-learning-based QoS-aware multipath routing protocol for wireless body area networks in IoMT, using adaptive multi-level queuing and fuzzy C-means clustering to optimize routing for different priority data.

entry.title: CPU Optimization of a Monocular 3D Biomechanics Pipeline for Low-Resource Deployment

author.name: Yan Zhang and Xiong Zhao

entry.summary: Optimizes a monocular 3D biomechanics pipeline for CPU-only execution, achieving 2.47x throughput increase and 59.6% runtime reduction through profiling-driven system optimization. Enables deployment on consumer hardware without GPU.

entry.title: Federated Learning with Quantum Enhanced LSTM for Applications in High Energy Physics

author.name: Abhishek Sawaika, Durga Pritam Suggisetti, Udaya Parampalli, Rajkumar Buyya

entry.summary: Proposes federated learning with quantum-enhanced LSTM for high energy physics, combining quantum computing's representational power with federated learning to handle distributed, information-critical datasets.

entry.title: Fusing Cellular Network Data and Tollbooth Counts for Urban Traffic Flow Estimation

author.name: Oluwaleke Yusuf, Shaira Tabassum

entry.summary: Develops a machine learning framework to correct and disaggregate cellular network data using sparse tollbooth counts as ground truth for urban traffic estimation, enabling vehicle-category-specific origin-destination inference.

entry.title: Similarity-Based Bike Station Expansion via Hybrid Denoising Autoencoders

author.name: Oluwaleke Yusuf, M. Tsaqif Wismadi, Adil Rasheed

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid denoising autoencoder framework for bike-sharing station expansion that learns latent representations from multi-source urban features, selecting expansion candidates based on similarity to desirable existing stations.

entry.title: Impact of Nonlinear Power Amplifier on Massive MIMO: Machine Learning Prediction Under Realistic Radio Channel

author.name: Marcin Hoffmann, Pawe{\l} Kryszkiewicz

entry.summary: Uses machine learning to predict the impact of nonlinear power amplifiers on Massive MIMO OFDM systems under realistic radio channel conditions, addressing the gap between idealized linear assumptions and real hardware behavior.

entry.title: Breakout-picker: Reducing false positives in deep learning-based borehole breakout characterization from acoustic image logs

author.name: Guangyu Wang, Xiaodong Ma, and Xinming Wu

entry.summary: Develops Breakout-picker, a deep learning framework for automated borehole breakout characterization from acoustic image logs with focus on reducing false positives for in-situ stress analysis.

entry.title: Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning for Building Heating Control and Demand-side Flexibility

author.name: Colin J\"uni, Mina Montazeri, Yi Guo, Federica Bellizio, Giovanni Sansavini, Philipp Heer

entry.summary: Presents a safe deep reinforcement learning framework for building space heating control that optimizes energy cost while maintaining occupant comfort and providing demand-side flexibility. Uses deep deterministic policy gradient with safety constraints for grid stability.

entry.title: DenTab: A Dataset for Table Recognition and Visual QA on Real-World Dental Estimates

author.name: Laziz Hamdi, Amine Tamasna, Thierry Paquet

entry.summary: Introduces DenTab, a dataset of 2,000 dental estimate table images with HTML annotations for table recognition and visual QA under noisy real-world conditions, including 2,208 questions across eleven categories.

entry.title: SWNet: A Cross-Spectral Network for Camouflaged Weed Detection

author.name: Henry O. Velesaca, Luigi Miranda, Angel D. Sappa

entry.summary: Presents SWNet, a cross-spectral network combining visible and near-infrared imaging with a Pyramid Vision Transformer backbone for detecting camouflaged weeds in agricultural settings.

entry.title: Characterising LLM-Generated Competency Questions: a Cross-Domain Empirical Study using Open and Closed Models

author.name: Reham Alharbi, Valentina Tamma, Terry R. Payne, Jacopo de Berardinis

entry.summary: Studies LLM-generated competency questions for ontology engineering across different models, characterizing observable properties of generated CQs and their variations across model types and domains.

entry.title: FL-MHSM: Spatially-adaptive Fusion and Ensemble Learning for Flood-Landslide Multi-Hazard Susceptibility Mapping at Regional Scale

author.name: Aswathi Mundayatt, Jaya Sreevalsan-Nair

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning workflow for joint flood-landslide multi-hazard susceptibility mapping combining spatial partitioning, early/late fusion, and Mixture of Experts modeling for Kerala.
