entry.summary: Introduces MemGround, a long-term memory benchmark for LLMs using gamified interactive scenarios. Features a three-tier framework evaluating Surface State Memory, Temporal Associative Memory, and Reasoning-Based Memory.

entry.title: Towards Verified and Targeted Explanations through Formal Methods

author.name: Hanchen David Wang, Diego Manzanas Lopez, Preston K. Robinette, Ipek Oguz, Taylor T. Johnson, Meiyi Ma

entry.summary: Proposes targeted formal verification for XAI, combining attribution guidance with formal guarantees to identify safety-critical misclassification boundaries rather than nearest boundaries. Applied to autonomous driving scenarios.

entry.title: CROP: Token-Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models via Regularized Prompt Optimization

author.name: Deep Shah, Sanket Badhe, Nehal Kathrotia, Priyanka Tiwari

entry.summary: Proposes CROP, a cost-regularized prompt optimization method that adds response length regularization to automatic prompt optimization, achieving 80.6% token reduction while maintaining accuracy on reasoning benchmarks.

entry.title: Modular Continual Learning via Zero-Leakage Reconstruction Routing and Autonomous Task Discovery

author.name: Noureddine Kermiche

entry.summary: Proposes a modular continual learning architecture with task-specific experts, an outlier-based gatekeeper, and a simultaneous pipeline for parallel teacher/student/router learning. Achieves structural parameter isolation to prevent catastrophic forgetting while complying with privacy mandates.

entry.title: Bounded Autonomy for Enterprise AI: Typed Action Contracts and Consumer-Side Execution

author.name: Sarmad Sohail, Ghufran Haider

entry.summary: Proposes a bounded-autonomy architecture for enterprise AI where LLMs interpret intent but execution is constrained by typed action contracts, permission-aware capability exposure, and consumer-side execution boundaries.

entry.title: UniDoc-RL: Coarse-to-Fine Visual RAG with Hierarchical Actions and Dense Rewards

author.name: Jun Wang, Shuo Tan, Zelong Sun, Tiancheng Gu, Yongle Zhao, Ziyong Feng, Kaicheng Yang, Cewu Lu

entry.summary: Proposes UniDoc-RL, a unified RL framework where an LVLM agent jointly performs retrieval, reranking, active visual perception, and reasoning through a hierarchical action space, progressively refining visual evidence from coarse to fine-grained.

entry.title: Structure as Computation: Developmental Generation of Minimal Neural Circuits

author.name: Duan Zhou

entry.summary: Simulates cortical neurogenesis from a single stem cell using gene regulatory rules from mouse transcriptomic data, producing 85 mature neurons that achieve 90%+ MNIST accuracy after one training epoch. Explores minimal neural circuits.

entry.title: Compressing Sequences in the Latent Embedding Space: $K$-Token Merging for Large Language Models

author.name: Zihao Xu, John Harvill, Ziwei Fan, Yizhou Sun, Hao Ding, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes K-Token Merging, a latent-space compression framework that merges contiguous blocks of K token embeddings into single embeddings via lightweight encoders, processed by LoRA-adapted LLMs for efficient long-prompt processing.

entry.title: Agentic Microphysics: A Manifesto for Generative AI Safety

author.name: Federico Pierucci, Matteo Prandi, Marcantonio Bracale Syrnikov, Marcello Galisai, Piercosma Bisconti

entry.summary: Proposes a methodological framework ('Agentic Microphysics') for studying safety in multi-agent AI systems, arguing that safety analysis must shift from isolated models to interaction-level mechanisms that generate collective risks.

entry.title: Wasserstein Formulation of Reinforcement Learning. An Optimal Transport Perspective on Policy Optimization

author.name: Mathias Dus (IRMA)

entry.summary: Presents a geometric framework for RL that views policies as maps into Wasserstein space, defining a Riemannian structure and deriving gradient flows using Otto's calculus with second-order analysis.

entry.title: LongAct: Harnessing Intrinsic Activation Patterns for Long-Context Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Bowen Ping, Zijun Chen, Tingfeng Hui, Qize Yu, Chenxuan Li, Junchi Yan, Baobao Chang

entry.summary: LongAct exploits high-magnitude activations in query/key vectors during long-context processing to guide RL training of LLMs, treating these as pivotal weights for optimization with selective masking.

entry.title: Decoupling Scores and Text: The Politeness Principle in Peer Review

author.name: Yingxuan Wen

entry.summary: Analyzes 30,000+ ICLR submissions finding a significant gap between score-based (91%) and text-based (81%) acceptance prediction, explained by the 'politeness principle' where reviewers soften negative textual feedback.

entry.title: Polyformer: a generative framework for thermodynamic modeling of polymeric molecules

author.name: Alessio Valentini, David Pekker, Chungwen Liang, Todd Martinez, Swagatam Mukhopadhyay

entry.summary: Polyformer is a generative framework for thermodynamic modeling of polymeric molecules that generates conformational ensembles given sequence and temperature, going beyond single-structure prediction like AlphaFold.

entry.title: A Synonymous Variational Perspective on the Rate-Distortion-Perception Tradeoff

author.name: Zijian Liang, Kai Niu, Changshuo Wang, Jin Xu, Ping Zhang

entry.summary: Provides a theoretical foundation for the rate-distortion-perception (RDP) framework by reformulating perceptual reconstruction through synonymous sets from semantic information theory. Establishes a synonymous source coding architecture that theoretically justifies the divergence-based perceptual quality measure.

entry.title: PUFFIN: Protein Unit Discovery with Functional Supervision

author.name: G\"ok\c{c}e Uludo\u{g}an, Buse Giledereli, Elif Ozkirimli, Arzucan \"Ozg\"ur

entry.summary: Introduces PUFFIN, a data-driven framework for discovering protein functional units by jointly learning structural segmentation and functional associations. Identifies intermediate-scale protein units between residues and full proteins.

entry.title: Atropos: Improving Cost-Benefit Trade-off of LLM-based Agents under Self-Consistency with Early Termination and Model Hotswap

author.name: Naryeong Kim, Shin Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes Atropos, a predictive early-termination and model hotswap technique to improve cost-benefit trade-offs for LLM-based agents using self-consistency. Detects when a smaller model will likely fail and escalates to a larger model.

entry.title: From Procedural Skills to Strategy Genes: Towards Experience-Driven Test-Time Evolution

author.name: Junjie Wang, Yiming Ren, Haoyang Zhang

entry.summary: Studies how reusable experience should be represented for test-time control and iterative evolution in scientific code-solving scenarios. Finds that compact 'Gene' representations outperform documentation-oriented 'Skill' packages across 4,590 controlled trials, suggesting representation format is a first-order factor for experience reuse.

entry.title: Deepfake Detection Generalization with Diffusion Noise

author.name: Hongyuan Qi, Wenjin Hou, Hehe Fan, Jun Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes an Attention-guided Noise Learning framework that integrates a pre-trained diffusion model into the deepfake detection pipeline, using the denoising process to expose subtle artifacts. Addresses generalization to diffusion-generated deepfakes that evade GAN-trained detectors.

entry.title: Quality-Aware Calibration for AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild

author.name: Fabrizio Guillaro, Vincenzo De Rosa, Davide Cozzolino, Luisa Verdoliva

entry.summary: QuAD proposes a quality-aware calibration framework for AI-generated image detection that considers multiple near-duplicate versions of the same image circulating online. Retrieves online near-duplicates and aggregates their forensic predictions for robust detection.

entry.title: AnimationBench: Are Video Models Good at Character-Centric Animation?

author.name: Leyi Wu, Pengjun Fang, Kai Sun, Yazhou Xing, Yinwei Wu, Songsong Wang, Ziqi Huang, Dan Zhou, Yingqing He, Ying-Cong Chen, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: AnimationBench introduces the first systematic benchmark for evaluating animation-style image-to-video generation, operationalizing the Twelve Basic Principles of Animation and IP Preservation into measurable evaluation dimensions. Addresses the gap that existing benchmarks focus on realistic video.

entry.title: Think in Latent Thoughts: A New Paradigm for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation

author.name: Yiyang Jiang, Li Zhang, Xiao-Yong Wei, Li Qing

entry.summary: Proposes a reasoning-driven sign language translation framework using latent thoughts as an intermediate layer between video and text. Uses plan-then-ground decoding where the model first decides what to say then looks back at video evidence.

entry.title: HRDexDB: A Large-Scale Dataset of Dexterous Human and Robotic Hand Grasps

author.name: Jongbin Lim, Taeyun Ha, Mingi Choi, Jisoo Kim, Byungjun Kim, Subin Jeon, Hanbyul Joo

entry.summary: Presents HRDexDB, a large-scale multi-modal dataset of dexterous grasping sequences for both human and robotic hands across 100 objects, including tactile signals, multi-view video, and egocentric streams. This fills a significant gap in cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation research by providing high-fidelity ground truth motion data.

entry.title: Attempting to Quantify Chinese Bias in Open-Source LLMs

author.name: Ethan Le Sage

entry.summary: Attempts to systematically quantify Chinese government-related bias in open-source LLMs by generating probe questions from Wikipedia articles, testing multiple Chinese and non-Chinese models, and using a judge LLM to score bias levels.

entry.title: Evo-MedAgent: Beyond One-Shot Diagnosis with Agents That Remember, Reflect, and Improve

author.name: Weixiang Shen, Bailiang Jian, Jun Li, Che Liu, Johannes Moll, Xiaobin Hu, Daniel Rueckert, Hongwei Bran Li, Jiazhen Pan

entry.summary: Proposes Evo-MedAgent, a self-evolving memory module for medical AI agents that accumulates experience across cases at test time through retrospective episodes, reasoning strategies, and confidence models, improving chest X-ray interpretation.

entry.title: Quantifying Cross-Query Contradictions in Multi-Query LLM Reasoning

author.name: Rohit Kumar Salla, Ramya Manasa Amancherla, Manoj Saravanan

entry.summary: Studies cross-query logical consistency in LLMs, introducing a benchmark of 390 multi-query reasoning instances and a solver-augmented approach that reduces contradictions (SetCons: 0.56→0.94) while preserving per-query accuracy.

entry.title: Targeted Exploration via Unified Entropy Control for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chen Wang, Lai Wei, Yanzhi Zhang, Chenyang Shao, Zedong Dan, Weiran Huang, Ge Lan, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Proposes UEC-RL, a framework addressing entropy collapse in GRPO by providing targeted exploration on difficult prompts and stabilization on easy ones, improving reasoning in LLMs and VLMs.

entry.title: SGA-MCTS: Decoupling Planning from Execution via Training-Free Atomic Experience Retrieval

author.name: Xin Xie, Dongyun Xue, Wuguannan Yao, Mingxiao Feng, Wengang Zhou, Xiang Qi, Houqiang Li, Peng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SGA-MCTS, a framework that casts LLM planning as non-parametric retrieval of de-lexicalized State-Goal-Action atoms distilled from MCTS exploration, enabling training-free planning with strong generalization.

entry.title: Beyond Literal Summarization: Redefining Hallucination for Medical SOAP Note Evaluation

author.name: Bhavik Vachhani, Kush Shrisvastava, Pranshu Nema, Sai Chiranthan

entry.summary: Redefines hallucination evaluation for medical SOAP note generation, showing that current metrics systematically misclassify clinically valid transformations (abstraction, normalization, inference) as hallucinations.

entry.title: Intermediate Layers Encode Optimal Biological Representations in Single-Cell Foundation Models

author.name: Vincenzo Yuto Civale, Roberto Semeraro, Andrew David Bagdanov, Alberto Magi

entry.summary: Reveals that optimal feature extraction layers in single-cell foundation models are task-dependent and context-dependent, with intermediate layers outperforming final layers by up to 31%, challenging standard last-layer extraction practices.

entry.title: Towards Faster Language Model Inference Using Mixture-of-Experts Flow Matching

author.name: Aihua Li

entry.summary: Proposes MoE-FM (Mixture-of-Experts Flow Matching) for non-autoregressive language modeling, using locally specialized vector fields to handle complex latent distributions, achieving faster inference than diffusion-based approaches.

entry.title: How Do LLMs and VLMs Understand Viewpoint Rotation Without Vision? An Interpretability Study

author.name: Zhen Yang, Ping Jian, Zhongbin Guo, Zuming Zhang, Chengzhi Li, Yonghong Deng, Xinyue Zhang, Wenpeng Lu

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs and VLMs can understand viewpoint rotation using only text inputs (no visual information). Studies spatial intelligence from a purely linguistic perspective through interpretability analysis.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Detect Methodological Flaws? Evidence from Gesture Recognition for UAV-Based Rescue Operation Based on Deep Learning

author.name: Domonkos Varga

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs can independently detect methodological flaws (specifically data leakage) in published machine learning papers. Evaluates 6 state-of-the-art LLMs on a gesture recognition paper with known evaluation protocol issues.

entry.title: Stateful Evidence-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Iterative Reasoning

author.name: Qi Dong, Ziheng Lin, Ning Ding

entry.summary: Proposes Stateful Evidence-Driven RAG with iterative reasoning, converting retrieved documents into structured reasoning units with relevance/confidence signals maintained in a persistent evidence pool for progressive evidence accumulation.

entry.title: The Devil Is in Gradient Entanglement: Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator for Robust Generalized Category Discovery

author.name: Haiyang Zheng, Nan Pu, Yaqi Cai, Teng Long, Wenjing Li, Nicu Sebe, Zhun Zhong

entry.summary: Identifies gradient entanglement as a key issue in Generalized Category Discovery and proposes Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator (EAGC), a plug-and-play module that disentangles gradient conflicts between supervised and unsupervised objectives.

entry.title: Mamba-SSM with LLM Reasoning for Biomarker Discovery: Causal Feature Refinement via Chain-of-Thought Gene Evaluation

author.name: Pushpa Kumar Balan, Aijing Feng

entry.summary: Combines Mamba SSM with LLM chain-of-thought reasoning for biomarker discovery. LLM-filtered gene set (17 genes) outperforms both raw saliency (50 genes) and 5,000-gene variance baseline on TCGA-BRCA.

entry.title: VeriGraphi: A Multi-Agent Framework of Hierarchical RTL Generation for Large Hardware Designs

author.name: Sazzadul Islam, Tasnim Tabassum, Hao Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces VeriGraphi, a multi-agent framework for generating hierarchical RTL/Verilog from complex hardware specifications. Uses a spec-anchored knowledge graph to maintain structural coherence across modules and reduce LLM hallucinations.

entry.title: AgileLog: A Forkable Shared Log for Agents on Data Streams

author.name: Shreesha G. Bhat, Tony Hong, Michael Noguera, Ramnatthan Alagappan, Aishwarya Ganesan

entry.summary: Proposes AgileLog, a forkable shared log abstraction for AI agents operating on data streams. Addresses performance interference and safe agentic writes in streaming systems by enabling log forking.

entry.title: StoryCoder: Narrative Reformulation for Structured Reasoning in LLM Code Generation

author.name: Geonhui Jang, Dongyoon Han, YoungJoon Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes StoryCoder, which transforms code generation problems into coherent natural language narratives with task overview, constraints, and examples. Tests across 11 models and shows narrative reformulation improves code generation performance.

entry.title: RACER: Retrieval-Augmented Contextual Rapid Speculative Decoding

author.name: Zihong Zhang, Zuchao Li, Lefei Zhang, Ping Wang, Hai Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes RACER, a training-free speculative decoding method combining retrieved exact patterns with logit-driven future cues for faster LLM inference. Unifies retrieval-based and logits-based approaches.

entry.title: Improving Sparse Autoencoder with Dynamic Attention

author.name: Dongsheng Wang, Jinsen Zhang, Dawei Su, Hui Huang

entry.summary: Proposes using sparsemax-based dynamic attention mechanisms in sparse autoencoders for LLM interpretability, automatically determining activation sparsity levels without requiring additional regularization or hyperparameter tuning.

entry.title: TOPCELL: Topology Optimization of Standard Cell via LLMs

author.name: Zhan Song, Yu-Tung Liu, Chen Chen, Guoheng Sun, Jiaqi Yin, Chia-tung Ho, Ang Li, Haoxing Ren, Cunxi Yu

entry.summary: TOPCELL reformulates transistor topology optimization for standard cell design as a generative task using LLMs fine-tuned with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), achieving scalable exploration under circuit and layout constraints.

entry.title: Mean Flow Policy Optimization

author.name: Xiaoyi Dong, Xi Sheryl Zhang, Jian Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes using MeanFlow models (few-step flow-based generative models) as policy representations for online RL, addressing the training/inference overhead of diffusion-based approaches while optimizing under maximum entropy RL.

entry.title: Constraint-based Pre-training: From Structured Constraints to Scalable Model Initialization

author.name: Fu Feng, Yucheng Xie, Ruixiao Shi, Jing Wang, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Proposes constraint-based pre-training that disentangles size-agnostic knowledge into reusable weight templates with size-specific lightweight scalers, enabling efficient initialization of models at varying scales from a single pre-training run.

entry.title: Deployment of AI-Assisted Interventions: Capacity Constraints and Noisy Compliance

author.name: Carri W. Chan, Yi Han, Hannah Li, Benjamin L. Ranard

entry.summary: Shows that optimizing AI-assisted interventions solely for predictive accuracy is suboptimal when capacity constraints and probabilistic behavioral responses determine who actually receives service, requiring threshold optimization.

entry.title: HAMSA: Scanning-Free Vision State Space Models via SpectralPulseNet

author.name: Badri N. Patro, Vijay S. Agneeswaran

entry.summary: Proposes HAMSA, a scanning-free vision state space model operating in the spectral domain via FFT, eliminating complex scanning strategies used by Vim, VMamba, and SiMBA. Introduces SpectralPulseNet for adaptive spectral modulation.

entry.title: A Nonlinear Separation Principle: Applications to Neural Networks, Control and Learning

author.name: Anand Gokhale, Anton V. Proskurnikov, Yu Kawano, Francesco Bullo

entry.summary: Introduces a nonlinear separation principle for recurrent neural networks guaranteeing global exponential stability, with applications to control design and implicit deep learning. Derives sharp LMI conditions for contractivity of firing rate and Hopfield architectures.

entry.title: Psychological Steering of Large Language Models

author.name: Leonardo Blas, Robin Jia, Emilio Ferrara

entry.summary: Introduces a psychological steering framework for LLMs that performs unbounded, fluency-constrained sweeps in semantically calibrated units derived from psychological artifacts (IPIP-NEO-120 personality test). Enables more controlled personality manipulation.

entry.title: IE as Cache: Information Extraction Enhanced Agentic Reasoning

author.name: Hang Lv, Sheng Liang, Hongchao Gu, Wei Guo, Defu Lian, Yong Liu, Hao Wang, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes IE-as-Cache, a framework that repurposes information extraction as a cognitive cache for agentic reasoning. Combines query-driven extraction with cache-aware reasoning to dynamically maintain compact intermediate information.

entry.title: MADE: A Living Benchmark for Multi-Label Text Classification with Uncertainty Quantification of Medical Device Adverse Events

author.name: Raunak Agarwal, Markus Wenzel, Simon Baur, Jonas Zimmer, George Harvey, Jackie Ma

entry.summary: Introduces MADE, a living benchmark for multi-label text classification of medical device adverse events, continuously updated to prevent data contamination. Features long-tailed distributions and built-in uncertainty quantification evaluation.

entry.title: FoodSense: A Multisensory Food Dataset and Benchmark for Predicting Taste, Smell, Texture, and Sound from Images

author.name: Sabab Ishraq (University of Central Florida, College of Engineering and Computer Science, Orlando, FL, USA), Aarushi Aarushi (University of Central Florida, College of Business Administration, Orlando, FL, USA), Juncai Jiang (University of Central Florida, College of Business Administration, Orlando, FL, USA), Chen Chen (University of Central Florida, Institute of Artificial Intelligence, Orlando, FL, USA)

entry.summary: Introduces FoodSense, a human-annotated dataset of 66,842 participant-image pairs for predicting taste, smell, texture, and sound from food images. Represents a new direction in cross-sensory inference from visual inputs, moving beyond standard food recognition tasks.

entry.title: High-Speed Full-Color HDR Imaging via Unwrapping Modulo-Encoded Spike Streams

author.name: Chu Zhou, Siqi Yang, Kailong Zhang, Heng Guo, Zhaofei Yu, Boxin Shi, Imari Sato

entry.summary: Presents a complete modulo-based HDR imaging system enabling high-speed, full-color HDR acquisition by combining novel sensing formulation (exposure-decoupled) with improved unwrapping algorithms. Addresses the fundamental tradeoff between motion artifacts and information loss in HDR.

entry.title: DETR-ViP: Detection Transformer with Robust Discriminative Visual Prompts

author.name: Bo Qian, Dahu Shi, Xing Wei

entry.summary: DETR-ViP investigates why visual-prompted object detection underperforms and identifies the absence of global discriminability in visual prompts as the root cause. Proposes robust discriminative visual prompts for improved open-vocabulary detection.

entry.title: How to Correctly Make Mistakes: A Framework for Constructing and Benchmarking Mistake Aware Egocentric Procedural Videos

author.name: Olga Loginova, Frank Keller

entry.summary: PIE-V presents a framework for constructing mistake-aware egocentric procedural videos by augmenting clean procedures with controlled, psychologically plausible error injection and correction planning. Addresses the scarcity of naturally occurring error data in procedural datasets.

entry.title: StreamCacheVGGT: Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers with Robust Scoring and Hybrid Cache Compression

author.name: Xuanyi Liu, Deyi Ji, Chunan Yu, Qi Zhu, Xuanfu Li, Jin Ma, Tianrun Chen, Lanyun Zhu

entry.summary: StreamCacheVGGT proposes a training-free framework for streaming 3D reconstruction with constant memory, using Cross-Layer Consistency-Enhanced Scoring and Hybrid Cache Compression to improve over pure-eviction cache management strategies.

entry.title: Switch: Learning Agile Skills Switching for Humanoid Robots

author.name: Yuen-Fui Lau, Qihan Zhao, Yinhuai Wang, Runyi Yu, Hok Wai Tsui, Qifeng Chen, Ping Tan

entry.summary: Introduces Switch, a hierarchical multi-skill system for humanoid robots enabling seamless skill transitions at any moment, using a Skill Graph for cross-skill transitions, whole-body tracking policy via deep RL, and presumably a high-level skill switching mechanism.

entry.title: Mistake gating leads to energy and memory efficient continual learning

author.name: Aaron Pache, Mark CW van Rossum

entry.summary: Proposes 'mistake-gated learning' inspired by human negativity bias, where neural network updates only occur on misclassified samples, reducing parameter updates by 50-80% while maintaining performance, particularly beneficial for continual/incremental learning.

entry.title: Perspective on Bias in Biomedical AI: Preventing Downstream Healthcare Disparities

author.name: Michal Rosen-Zvi, Yoav Kan-Tor, Michael Danziger, Agata Ferretti, Javier Aula-Blasco, Julia Falcao, Ron Shamir, Mordechai Muszkat

entry.summary: Analyzes bias in biomedical AI by examining 4,719 omics publications, finding that demographic information is rarely reported and heavily biased when it is, highlighting how upstream data collection biases propagate into AI-driven healthcare disparities.

entry.title: El Agente Forjador: Task-Driven Agent Generation for Quantum Simulation

author.name: Zijian Zhang, Aiwei Yin, Amaan Baweja, Jiaru Bai, Ignacio Gustin, Varinia Bernales, Al\'an Aspuru-Guzik

entry.summary: Presents El Agente Forjador, a multi-agent framework for quantum simulation where coding agents autonomously create, validate, and reuse computational tools across 24 tasks in quantum chemistry and dynamics.

entry.title: Layered Mutability: Continuity and Governance in Persistent Self-Modifying Agents

author.name: Krti Tallam

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for reasoning about self-modifying persistent AI agents through 'layered mutability' across five layers, arguing governance difficulty increases when mutation is rapid, coupling is strong, reversibility is weak, and observability is low.

entry.title: MirrorBench: Evaluating Self-centric Intelligence in MLLMs by Introducing a Mirror

author.name: Shengyu Guo, Tongrui Ye, Jianbo Zhang, Zicheng Zhang, Chunyi Li, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Introduces MirrorBench, a simulation-based benchmark inspired by the Mirror Self-Recognition test from psychology, evaluating embodied MLLMs on self-centric intelligence through progressively challenging tasks.

entry.title: Dual-Axis Generative Reward Model Toward Semantic and Turn-taking Robustness in Interactive Spoken Dialogue Models

author.name: Yifu Chen, Shengpeng Ji, Zhengqing Liu, Qian Chen, Wen Wang, Ziqing Wang, Yangzhuo Li, Tianle Liang, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-axis generative reward model for spoken dialogue models that evaluates both semantic quality and turn-taking behavior, addressing the lack of reliable reward signals for RL in full-duplex spoken dialogue.

entry.title: WavAlign: Enhancing Intelligence and Expressiveness in Spoken Dialogue Models via Adaptive Hybrid Post-Training

author.name: Yifu Chen, Shengpeng Ji, Qian Chen, Tianle Liang, Yangzhuo Li, Ziqing Wang, Wen Wang, Jingyu Lu, Haoxiao Wang, Xueyi Pu, Fan Zhuo, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes WavAlign for enhancing spoken dialogue models through adaptive hybrid post-training, analyzing obstacles of applying preference optimization to speech and addressing sparse supervision with dense generation challenges.

entry.title: Dr.~RTL: Autonomous Agentic RTL Optimization through Tool-Grounded Self-Improvement

author.name: Wenji Fang, Yao Lu, Shang Liu, Jing Wang, Ziyan Guo, Junxian He, Fengbin Tu, Zhiyao Xie

entry.summary: Presents Dr.RTL, an agentic framework for realistic RTL timing optimization with continual self-improvement through reusable optimization skills, evaluated on realistic (not manually degraded) designs.

entry.title: SAGE Celer 2.6 Technical Card

author.name: SAGEA Research Team, Basab Jha, Firoj Paudel, Ujjwal Puri, Adrian Liu, Ethan Henkel, Zhang Yuting, Mateusz Kowalczyk, Mei Huang, Choi Donghyuk, Wang Junhao

entry.summary: Introduces SAGE Celer 2.6, a general-purpose model family (5B/10B/27B) with 'Inverse Reasoning' pipeline for self-validation of logic paths, natively integrated multimodal functionality, and competitive benchmark results.

entry.title: Grading the Unspoken: Evaluating Tacit Reasoning in Quantum Field Theory and String Theory with LLMs

author.name: Xingyang Yu, Yinghuan Zhang, Yufei Zhang, Zijun Cui

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs on quantum field theory and string theory problems using a five-level grading rubric that separates tacit reasoning from surface-level correctness. Finds that standard metrics fail to capture whether conceptual steps are properly reconstructed.

entry.title: Knowledge Graph RAG: Agentic Crawling and Graph Construction in Enterprise Documents

author.name: Koushik Chakraborty, Koyel Guha

entry.summary: Proposes agentic knowledge graphs with recursive crawling for enterprise document retrieval, demonstrating 70% accuracy improvement over standard vector-based RAG on the Code of Federal Regulations.

entry.title: Optimistic Policy Learning under Pessimistic Adversaries with Regret and Violation Guarantees

author.name: Sourav Ganguly, Kartik Pandit, Arnob Ghosh

entry.summary: Studies optimistic policy learning under pessimistic adversaries in constrained MDPs with exogenous factors, providing regret and violation guarantees for safety-critical decision-making with adversarial state transitions.

entry.title: CBCL: Safe Self-Extending Agent Communication

author.name: Hugo O'Connor

entry.summary: Presents CBCL, an agent communication language that constrains all messages including runtime extensions to deterministic context-free language class. Safety invariants are machine-checked in Lean 4 and enforced in a Rust implementation.

entry.title: Generative Augmented Inference

author.name: Cheng Lu, Mengxin Wang, Dennis J. Zhang, Heng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Generative Augmented Inference (GAI), a framework that uses AI-generated outputs as informative features rather than direct proxies for human labels in operations management. Provides theoretical efficiency guarantees for the approach.

entry.title: ClimateCause: Complex and Implicit Causal Structures in Climate Reports

author.name: Liesbeth Allein, Nataly Pineda-Casta\~neda, Andrea Rocci, Marie-Francine Moens

entry.summary: Introduces ClimateCause, an expert-annotated dataset of higher-order causal structures from climate reports, including implicit and nested causality. Evaluates LLMs on causal reasoning over this challenging data.

entry.title: VisPCO: Visual Token Pruning Configuration Optimization via Budget-Aware Pareto-Frontier Learning for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Huawei Ji, Yuanhao Sun, Yuan Jin, Cheng Deng, Jiaxin Ding, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang

entry.summary: VisPCO formulates visual token pruning in vision-language models as a Pareto configuration optimization problem, using continuous relaxation and gradient-based search to automatically find optimal pruning configurations rather than relying on predefined ones.

entry.title: ConfLayers: Adaptive Confidence-based Layer Skipping for Self-Speculative Decoding

author.name: Walaa Amer, Uday das, Fadi Kurdahi

entry.summary: ConfLayers proposes confidence-based intermediate layer skipping for self-speculative decoding, dynamically forming draft models as a plug-and-play approach without learned skip patterns.

entry.title: Blazing the trails before beating the path: Sample-efficient Monte-Carlo planning

author.name: Jean-Bastien Grill, Michal Valko, R\'emi Munos

entry.summary: Proposes a sample-efficient Monte-Carlo planning algorithm for MDPs that exploits structure by exploring only near-optimal states, providing sample complexity guarantees dependent on the quantity of near-optimal states.

entry.title: RL-STPA: Adapting System-Theoretic Hazard Analysis for Safety-Critical Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Steven A. Senczyszyn, Timothy C. Havens, Nathaniel Rice, Jason E. Summers, Benjamin D. Werner, Benjamin J. Schumeg

entry.summary: RL-STPA adapts System-Theoretic Process Analysis for safety-critical RL deployments, introducing hierarchical subtask decomposition, coverage-guided perturbation testing, and iterative analysis checkpoints.

entry.title: Scalable Model-Based Clustering with Sequential Monte Carlo

author.name: Connie Trojan, Pavel Myshkov, Paul Fearnhead, James Hensman, Tom Minka, Christopher Nemeth

entry.summary: Proposes a novel SMC algorithm for scalable model-based clustering that decomposes problems into approximately independent subproblems. Motivated by knowledge base construction and demonstrated on text data clustering.

entry.title: Pushing the Boundaries of Multiple Choice Evaluation to One Hundred Options

author.name: Nahyun Lee, Guijin Son

entry.summary: Proposes scaling multiple choice evaluation to 100 options to reduce shortcut strategies and chance performance in LLM benchmarking. Demonstrates on Korean orthography error detection that strong low-option performance doesn't transfer to high-option settings.

entry.title: CURA: Clinical Uncertainty Risk Alignment for Language Model-Based Risk Prediction

author.name: Sizhe Wang, Ziqi Xu, Claire Najjuuko, Charles Alba, Chenyang Lu

entry.summary: Proposes CURA, a framework aligning clinical LM uncertainty estimates with individual error likelihoods and cohort-level ambiguities for risk prediction from clinical notes. Uses bi-level uncertainty objective with individual and cohort calibration.

entry.title: Controlling Authority Retrieval: A Missing Retrieval Objective for Authority-Governed Knowledge

author.name: Andre Bacellar

entry.summary: Formalizes Controlling Authority Retrieval (CAR) as a mathematical problem distinct from standard semantic retrieval, where later documents can formally void earlier ones (e.g., in law, drug regulation). Provides theoretical characterizations including necessary-and-sufficient conditions for correct retrieval and identifiability bounds.

entry.title: DVFace: Spatio-Temporal Dual-Prior Diffusion for Video Face Restoration

author.name: Zheng Chen, Bowen Chai, Rongjun Gao, Mingtao Nie, Xi Li, Bingnan Duan, Jianping Fang, Xiaohong Liu, Linghe Kong, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: DVFace proposes a one-step diffusion framework for real-world video face restoration that achieves temporal coherence and faithful facial recovery simultaneously. Moves beyond multi-step sampling and generic diffusion priors with face-specific adaptations.

entry.title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Video Saliency Prediction: Methods and Results

author.name: Andrey Moskalenko, Alexey Bryncev, Ivan Kosmynin, Kira Shilovskaya, Mikhail Erofeev, Dmitry Vatolin, Radu Timofte, Kun Wang, Yupeng Hu, Zhiran Li, Hao Liu, Qianlong Xiang, Liqiang Nie, Konstantinos Chaldaiopoulos, Niki Efthymiou, Athanasia Zlatintsi, Panagiotis Filntisis, Katerina Pastra, Petros Maragos, Li Yang, Gen Zhan, Yiting Liao, Yabin Zhang, Yuxin Liu, Xu Wu, Yunheng Zheng, Linze Li, Kun He, Cong Wu, Xuefeng Zhu, Tianyang Xu, Xiaojun Wu, Wenzhuo Zhao, Keren Fu, Gongyang Li, Shixiang Shi, Jianlin Chen, Haibin Ling, Yaoxin Jiang, Guoyi Xu, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi, Jiachen Tu

entry.summary: Overview of the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Video Saliency Prediction, featuring a novel dataset of 2,000 videos with crowd-sourced eye tracking data from 5,000+ assessors. Seven teams completed the final evaluation phase.

entry.title: Hybrid Latents -- Geometry-Appearance-Aware Surfel Splatting

author.name: Neel Kelkar, Simon Niedermayr, Klaus Engel, R\"udiger Westermann

entry.summary: Introduces a hybrid Gaussian-hash-grid radiance representation that separates low- and high-frequency scene components for improved 3DGS reconstruction. Uses per-Gaussian latent features alongside hash-grid features with hard opacity falloffs.

entry.title: TokenLight: Precise Lighting Control in Images using Attribute Tokens

author.name: Sumit Chaturvedi, Yannick Hold-Geoffroy, Mengwei Ren, Jingyuan Liu, He Zhang, Yiqun Mei, Julie Dorsey, Zhixin Shu

entry.summary: TokenLight introduces attribute tokens for precise, continuous control over multiple illumination attributes in image relighting, including intensity, color, ambient illumination, diffuse level, and 3D light positions. Trained on synthetic data with real captures for generalization.

entry.title: Abstract Sim2Real through Approximate Information States

author.name: Yunfu Deng, Yuhao Li, Josiah P. Hanna

entry.summary: Formalizes the 'abstract sim2real' problem—transferring policies from simulators that model tasks at a coarse level of abstraction—using approximate information states to bridge the gap between abstract simulators and real-world deployment.

entry.title: What economists get wrong (and sometimes right!) about AI

author.name: dan.parshall

entry.summary: Analyzes what economists get wrong about transformative AI, criticizing Acemoglu's influential paper that predicted AI would have minimal economic impact (0.5% GDP), and discussing how few economists take transformative AI seriously. Highlights Restrepo's labor replacement predictions.

entry.title: CI-CBM: Class-Incremental Concept Bottleneck Model for Interpretable Continual Learning

author.name: Amirhosein Javadi, Tuomas Oikarinen, Tara Javidi, Tsui-Wei Weng

entry.summary: CI-CBM introduces a class-incremental concept bottleneck model that maintains interpretable decision processes throughout continual learning using concept regularization and pseudo-concept generation.

entry.title: MinShap: A Modified Shapley Value Approach for Feature Selection

author.name: Chenghui Zheng, Garvesh Raskutti

entry.summary: Proposes MinShap, a modified Shapley value approach adapted for feature selection by capturing direct effects while minimizing indirect effects through other features. Combines game-theoretic attribution with feature selection.

entry.title: TurboTalk: Progressive Distillation for One-Step Audio-Driven Talking Avatar Generation

author.name: Xiangyu Liu, Feng Gao, Xiaomei Zhang, Yong Zhang, Xiaoming Wei, Zhen Lei, Xiangyu Zhu

entry.summary: TurboTalk proposes a two-stage progressive distillation framework that compresses multi-step audio-driven video diffusion models into single-step generators for talking avatar generation. Uses Distribution Matching Distillation followed by adversarial distillation.

entry.title: Switch-KD: Visual-Switch Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Haoyi Sun, Xiaoxiao Wang, Ning Mao, Qian Wang, Lifu Mu, Wen Zheng, Tao Wei, Wei Chen

entry.summary: Switch-KD proposes a visual-switch distillation framework for Vision-Language Models that addresses the challenge of inconsistent multimodal knowledge transfer in KD by explicitly handling modality-specific supervision and multimodal alignment.

entry.title: AIBuildAI: An AI Agent for Automatically Building AI Models

author.name: Ruiyi Zhang, Peijia Qin, Qi Cao, Li Zhang, Pengtao Xie

entry.summary: Introduces AIBuildAI, an AI agent that automatically builds AI models from task descriptions and training data, covering the full development lifecycle beyond what existing AutoML methods handle.

entry.title: Response-Aware User Memory Selection for LLM Personalization

author.name: Jillian Fisher, Jennifer Neville, Chan Young Park

entry.summary: Proposes RUMS, a method for selecting user memory items for LLM personalization based on mutual information between memory subsets and model outputs, rather than simple semantic similarity to queries.

entry.title: CAMO: An Agentic Framework for Automated Causal Discovery from Micro Behaviors to Macro Emergence in LLM Agent Simulations

author.name: Xiangning Yu, Yuwei Guo, Yuqi Hou, Xiao Xue, Qun Ma

entry.summary: Introduces CAMO, an automated causal discovery framework for understanding micro-to-macro emergence in LLM agent simulations, converting mechanistic hypotheses into computable factors grounded in simulation records.

entry.title: The Agentification of Scientific Research: A Physicist's Perspective

author.name: Xiao-Liang Qi

entry.summary: A physicist's perspective arguing that AI's most important significance is in transforming how complex information and know-how are carried, replicated, and shared, with implications for scientific collaboration, discovery, and publishing.

entry.title: ADAPT: Benchmarking Commonsense Planning under Unspecified Affordance Constraints

author.name: Pei-An Chen, Yong-Ching Liang, Jia-Fong Yeh, Hung-Ting Su, Yi-Ting Chen, Min Sun, Winston Hsu

entry.summary: Introduces DynAfford benchmark and ADAPT module for evaluating embodied agents in dynamic environments where object affordances change over time and are unspecified in instructions, requiring commonsense planning.

entry.title: COEVO: Co-Evolutionary Framework for Joint Functional Correctness and PPA Optimization in LLM-Based RTL Generation

author.name: Heng Ping, Peiyu Zhang, Shixuan Li, Wei Yang, Anzhe Cheng, Shukai Duan, Xiaole Zhang, Paul Bogdan

entry.summary: Proposes COEVO, a co-evolutionary framework for RTL generation that jointly optimizes functional correctness and PPA (performance, power, area) within a single evolutionary loop, avoiding the common sequential decoupling.

entry.title: Where are the Humans? A Scoping Review of Fairness in Multi-agent AI Systems

author.name: Simeon Allmendinger, Luca Deck, Lucas Mueller

entry.summary: A scoping review synthesizing research on fairness in multi-agent AI systems. Finds that fairness is often addressed superficially, lacks normative foundations, and overlooks complex dynamics of agent autonomy and system-level interactions.

entry.title: Tug-of-War within A Decade: Conflict Resolution in Vulnerability Analysis via Teacher-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generations

author.name: Ziyin Zhou, Jianyi Zhang, Xu ji, Yilong Li, Jiameng Han, Zhangchi Zhao

entry.summary: Addresses knowledge conflicts in LLMs for CVE vulnerability analysis, where 30,000+ vulnerabilities have been updated over the past decade. Proposes teacher-guided RAG to resolve discrepancies between training data and current knowledge.

entry.title: Neuro-Oracle: A Trajectory-Aware Agentic RAG Framework for Interpretable Epilepsy Surgical Prognosis

author.name: Aizierjiang Aiersilan, Mohamad Koubeissi

entry.summary: Proposes Neuro-Oracle, a three-stage framework for epilepsy surgical prognosis that encodes pre-to-post-operative MRI trajectory changes, retrieves similar surgical cases, and generates natural language prognosis using a quantized Llama-3-8B agent.

entry.title: EuropeMedQA Study Protocol: A Multilingual, Multimodal Medical Examination Dataset for Language Model Evaluation

author.name: Francesco Andrea Causio, Vittorio De Vita, Olivia Riccomi, Michele Ferramola, Federico Felizzi, Antonio Cristiano, Lorenzo De Mori, Chiara Battipaglia, Melissa Sawaya, Luigi De Angelis, Marcello Di Pumpo, Alessandra Piscitelli, Pietro Eric Risuleo, Alessia Longo, Giulia Vojvodic, Mariapia Vassalli, Bianca Destro Castaniti, Nicol\`o Scarsi, Manuel Del Medico

entry.summary: Study protocol for EuropeMedQA, a multilingual, multimodal medical examination dataset from Italy, France, Spain, and Portugal for evaluating LLM cross-lingual transfer and visual reasoning in medical contexts.

entry.title: DharmaOCR: Specialized Small Language Models for Structured OCR that outperform Open-Source and Commercial Baselines

author.name: Gabriel Pimenta de Freitas Cardoso, Caio Lucas da Silva Chacon, Jonas Felipe da Fonseca Oliveira, Paulo Henrique de Medeiros Araujo

entry.summary: Introduces DharmaOCR, specialized small language models for structured OCR that jointly optimize transcription quality, stability, and cost. Proposes treating text degeneration as a first-class benchmark metric.

entry.title: Tight Sample Complexity Bounds for Best-Arm Identification Under Bounded Systematic Bias

author.name: Tianhao Qian

entry.summary: Frames autonomous reasoning node expansion as a Best-Arm Identification problem under bounded systematic bias, establishing sample complexity bounds showing safe elimination requires empirical reward gaps exceeding 4L.

entry.title: SpaceMind: A Modular and Self-Evolving Embodied Vision-Language Agent Framework for Autonomous On-orbit Servicing

author.name: Aodi Wu, Haodong Han, Xubo Luo, Ruisuo Wang, Shan He, Xue Wan

entry.summary: Presents SpaceMind, a modular VLM agent framework for autonomous on-orbit satellite servicing. Decomposes knowledge, tools, and reasoning into extensible dimensions with a skill self-evolution mechanism and MCP-Redis interface for simulation-to-hardware transfer.

entry.title: Mechanistic Decoding of Cognitive Constructs in LLMs

author.name: Yitong Shou, Manhao Guan

entry.summary: Proposes a Cognitive Reverse-Engineering framework using Representation Engineering to analyze how LLMs process complex emotions like jealousy. Isolates psychological antecedents through subspace orthogonalization and bidirectional causal steering.

entry.title: ELMoE-3D: Leveraging Intrinsic Elasticity of MoE for Hybrid-Bonding-Enabled Self-Speculative Decoding in On-Premises Serving

author.name: Yuseon Choi, Jingu Lee, Jungjun Oh, Sunjoo Whang, Byeongcheol Kim, Minsung Kim, Hoi-Jun Yoo, Sangjin Kim

entry.summary: Proposes ELMoE-3D, a hybrid-bonding hardware-software co-designed framework for efficient MoE model serving that unifies cache-based acceleration and speculative decoding to improve on-premises inference speed.

entry.title: GenRec: A Preference-Oriented Generative Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation

author.name: Yanyan Zou, Junbo Qi, Lunsong Huang, Yu Li, Kewei Xu, Jiabao Gao, Binglei Zhao, Xuanhua Yang, Sulong Xu, Shengjie Li

entry.summary: Presents GenRec, a preference-oriented generative recommendation framework deployed on JD App. Addresses pagination consistency, long sequence encoding costs, and preference alignment with page-wise NTP training within a decoder-only architecture.

entry.title: RaTA-Tool: Retrieval-based Tool Selection with Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Gabriele Mattioli, Evelyn Turri, Sara Sarto, Lorenzo Baraldi, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Rita Cucchiara

entry.summary: Introduces RaTA-Tool, a framework for open-world multimodal tool selection using retrieval-augmented approaches. Enables MLLMs to select tools from unseen pools based on multimodal user instructions.

entry.title: Agentic Explainability at Scale: Between Corporate Fears and XAI Needs

author.name: Yomna Elsayed, Cecily Jones

entry.summary: Explores explainability challenges in enterprise agentic AI at scale, addressing 'Agent Sprawl' and proposing design-time and runtime XAI techniques. Bridges AI governance concerns with practical observability needs.

entry.title: Amortized Optimal Transport from Sliced Potentials

author.name: Minh-Phuc Truong, Khai Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes novel amortized optimization methods for predicting optimal transport plans using Kantorovich potentials from sliced OT, with both regression-based and objective-based amortization strategies.

entry.title: SegWithU: Uncertainty as Perturbation Energy for Single-Forward-Pass Risk-Aware Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Tianhao Fu, Austin Wang, Charles Chen, Roby Aldave-Garza, Yucheng Chen

entry.summary: SegWithU is a post-hoc framework for medical image segmentation that adds a lightweight uncertainty head to a frozen backbone, modeling uncertainty as perturbation energy to produce calibrated voxel-wise uncertainty maps in a single forward pass.

entry.title: Path-Sampled Integrated Gradients

author.name: Firuz Kamalov, Fadi Thabtah, R. Sivaraj, Neda Abdelhamid

entry.summary: Path-sampled integrated gradients (PS-IG) generalizes feature attribution by computing expected values over baselines sampled along interpolation paths, proving equivalence to path-weighted IG and achieving improved convergence and variance reduction.

entry.title: FedIDM: Achieving Fast and Stable Convergence in Byzantine Federated Learning through Iterative Distribution Matching

author.name: He Yang, Dongyi Lv, Wei Xi, Song Ma, Hanlin Gu, Jizhong Zhao

entry.summary: FedIDM uses distribution matching to create trustworthy condensed data for identifying and filtering malicious clients in Byzantine-robust federated learning, achieving fast and stable convergence.

entry.title: BitFlipScope: Scalable Fault Localization and Recovery for Bit-Flip Corruptions in LLMs

author.name: Muhammad Zeeshan Karamat, Sadman Saif, Christiana Chamon Garcia

entry.summary: BitFlipScope is a framework for localizing bit-flip faults in LLM parameters caused by hardware degradation or attacks, enabling targeted recovery without full retraining.

entry.title: Doubly Outlier-Robust Online Infinite Hidden Markov Model

author.name: Horace Yiu, Leandro S\'anchez-Betancourt, \'Alvaro Cartea, Gerardo Duran-Martin

entry.summary: Derives a robust online update for infinite hidden Markov models that handles streaming data with outliers and model misspecification, balancing adaptivity and robustness using generalized Bayesian inference.

entry.title: Regret Tail Characterization of Optimal Bandit Algorithms with Generic Rewards

author.name: Subhodip Panda, Shubhada Agrawal

entry.summary: Extends KL-inf UCB algorithm to nonparametric reward distributions and establishes asymptotic optimality. Provides novel upper bounds on regret tail behavior for generic reward distributions beyond parametric exponential families.

entry.title: Beyond Independent Frames: Latent Attention Masked Autoencoders for Multi-View Echocardiography

author.name: Simon B\"ohi, Irene Cannistraci, Sergio Mu\~noz Gonzalez, Moritz Vandenhirtz, Sonia Laguna, Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo, Max Kr\"ahenmann, Andrea Agostini, Ece Ozkan, Thomas M. Sutter, Julia E. Vogt

entry.summary: Introduces LAMAE, a latent attention masked autoencoder for multi-view echocardiography that enables information exchange across frames and views in latent space. Designed as a foundation model for cardiac imaging.

entry.title: An Analysis of Regularization and Fokker-Planck Residuals in Diffusion Models for Image Generation

author.name: Onno Niemann, Gonzalo Mart\'inez Mu\~noz, Alberto Su\'arez Gonzalez

entry.summary: Investigates simpler regularization alternatives to expensive Fokker-Planck equation penalties in diffusion model training. Finds that lightweight regularizers can provide similar benefits without strict FP adherence.

entry.title: SPAGBias: Uncovering and Tracing Structured Spatial Gender Bias in Large Language Models

author.name: Binxian Su, Haoye Lou, Shucheng Zhu, Weikang Wang, Ying Liu, Dong Yu, Pengyuan Liu

entry.summary: Introduces SPAGBias, the first framework to evaluate spatial gender bias in LLMs, combining a taxonomy of 62 urban micro-spaces with three diagnostic layers. Tests six models and identifies structured gender-space associations beyond the public-private divide.

entry.title: DiscoTrace: Representing and Comparing Answering Strategies of Humans and LLMs in Information-Seeking Question Answering

author.name: Neha Srikanth, Jordan Boyd-Graber, Rachel Rudinger

entry.summary: Introduces DiscoTrace, a method to identify rhetorical strategies in answers to information-seeking questions using discourse acts. Reveals that human communities have diverse answering strategies while LLMs lack rhetorical diversity.

entry.title: Co-distilled attention guided masked image modeling with noisy teacher for self-supervised learning on medical images

author.name: Jue Jiang, Aneesh Rangnekar, Harini Veeraraghavan

entry.summary: Proposes an attention-guided masking mechanism for Swin Transformers within a co-distillation framework for self-supervised learning on medical images. Addresses the challenge that random masking is ineffective for medical images due to contextual similarity of neighboring patches.

entry.title: Giving Faces Their Feelings Back: Explicit Emotion Control for Feedforward Single-Image 3D Head Avatars

author.name: Yicheng Gong, Jiawei Zhang, Liqiang Liu, Yanwen Wang, Lei Chu, Jiahao Li, Hao Pan, Hao Zhu, Yan Lu

entry.summary: Presents a framework for explicit emotion control in single-image 3D head avatar reconstruction via dual-path modulation that separates emotion from speech-driven articulation. Treats emotion as a first-class independent control signal rather than entangling it with geometry.

entry.title: Prompt-Guided Image Editing with Masked Logit Nudging in Visual Autoregressive Models

author.name: Amir El-Ghoussani, Marc H\"olle, Gustavo Carneiro, Vasileios Belagiannis

entry.summary: Introduces Masked Logit Nudging for prompt-guided image editing in visual autoregressive models, using source image token maps to guide model predictions while preserving unrelated regions. Applies edits only within semantic masks.

entry.title: NG-GS: NeRF-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting Segmentation

author.name: Yi He, Tao Wang, Yi Jin, Congyan Lang, Yidong Li, Haibin Ling

entry.summary: NG-GS addresses boundary segmentation artifacts in 3D Gaussian Splatting by identifying ambiguous Gaussians at boundaries using mask variance analysis and constructing continuous feature fields via RBF interpolation with multi-resolution hash encoding.

entry.title: Boundary-Centric Active Learning for Temporal Action Segmentation

author.name: Halil Ismail Helvaci, Sen-ching Samson Cheung

entry.summary: B-ACT introduces a clip-budgeted active learning framework for temporal action segmentation that explicitly allocates supervision budget to high-leverage boundary regions where errors concentrate, using a hierarchical two-stage loop with boundary-aware scoring.

entry.title: CooperDrive: Enhancing Driving Decisions Through Cooperative Perception

author.name: Deyuan Qu, Qi Chen, Takayuki Shimizu, Onur Altintas

entry.summary: CooperDrive proposes a cooperative perception framework for autonomous vehicles that enables earlier, safer driving decisions through lightweight object-level sharing and fusion between vehicles. Reuses detector BEV features for pose estimation without additional encoders.

entry.title: Vision-Based Safe Human-Robot Collaboration with Uncertainty Guarantees

author.name: Jakob Thumm, Marian Frei, Tianle Ni, Matthias Althoff, Marco Pavone

entry.summary: Proposes a framework combining vision-based human pose estimation, motion prediction, and conformal prediction guarantees for certifiably safe human-robot collaboration. Integrates aleatoric uncertainty estimation with out-of-distribution detection for high-confidence safety guarantees.

entry.title: Keep It CALM: Toward Calibration-Free Kilometer-Level SLAM with Visual Geometry Foundation Models via an Assistant Eye

author.name: Tianjun Zhang, Fengyi Zhang, Tianchen Deng, Lin Zhang, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Presents CALM, a calibration-free SLAM system for kilometer-level mapping using Visual Geometry Foundation Models, arguing that single linear transforms are insufficient for sub-map alignment and proposing non-linear approaches to handle complex geometric distortions.

entry.title: On Dwarkesh Patel’s Podcast With Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's detailed analysis of Dwarkesh Patel's podcast interview with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, applying 'bounded distrust' frameworks to evaluate Huang's claims about AI infrastructure, compute scaling, and Nvidia's strategic positioning.

entry.title: From Black Box to Glass Box: Cross-Model ASR Disagreement to Prioto Review in Ambient AI Scribe Documentation

author.name: Abdolamir Karbalaie, Fernando Seoane, Farhad Abtahi

entry.summary: Investigates using cross-model disagreement among 8 ASR systems as a reference-free uncertainty signal to prioritize human verification in medical transcription workflows, without requiring human reference transcripts.

entry.title: Which bird does not have wings: Negative-constrained KGQA with Schema-guided Semantic Matching and Self-directed Refinement

author.name: Midan Shim, Seokju Hwang, Kaehyun Um, Kyong-Ho Lee

entry.summary: Introduces NEST KGQA, a new task and dataset for knowledge graph question answering with negative constraints. Proposes PyLF, a Python-format logical form for handling negation in KGQA.

entry.title: MM-WebAgent: A Hierarchical Multimodal Web Agent for Webpage Generation

author.name: Yan Li, Zezi Zeng, Yifan Yang, Yuqing Yang, Ning Liao, Weiwei Guo, Lili Qiu, Mingxi Cheng, Qi Dai, Zhendong Wang, Zhengyuan Yang, Xue Yang, Ji Li, Lijuan Wang, Chong Luo

entry.summary: MM-WebAgent is a hierarchical agentic framework for multimodal webpage generation that coordinates AIGC-based element generation through hierarchical planning and iterative self-reflection for global layout coherence.

entry.title: Beyond the Laplacian: Doubly Stochastic Matrices for Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Zhaobo Hu, Vincent Gauthier, Mehdi Naima

entry.summary: Proposes replacing the Laplacian in GNNs with a Doubly Stochastic Matrix derived from the inverse modified Laplacian, using Neumann series approximation and residual mass compensation for scalability.

entry.title: Chinese Language Is Not More Efficient Than English in Vibe Coding: A Preliminary Study on Token Cost and Problem-Solving Rate

author.name: Simiao Ren (Tsang), Xingyu Shen (Tsang), Yuchen Zhou (Tsang), Dennis (Tsang), Ng, Ankit Raj

entry.summary: Empirically tests the claim that Chinese prompts are more token-efficient than English for LLM coding tasks. Finds the efficiency advantage does not hold, with results varying by model architecture.

entry.title: Revisiting Token Compression for Accelerating ViT-based Sparse Multi-View 3D Object Detectors

author.name: Mingqian Ji, Shanshan Zhang, Jian Yang

entry.summary: SEPatch3D revisits token compression for ViT-based sparse multi-view 3D object detectors, finding that existing strategies (pruning, merging, patch enlargement) discard important information. Proposes dynamic patch size adjustment while preserving critical semantic information.

entry.title: The Courtroom Trial of Pixels: Robust Image Manipulation Localization via Adversarial Evidence and Reinforcement Learning Judgment

author.name: Songlin Li, Zhiqing Guo, Dan Ma, Changtao Miao, Gaobo Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a courtroom-style framework for image manipulation localization that explicitly models adversarial evidence (manipulated vs. authentic) and uses reinforcement learning for judgment. Addresses the limitation of existing methods that don't explicitly compare manipulated and authentic evidence.

entry.title: One-shot Compositional 3D Head Avatars with Deformable Hair

author.name: Yuan Sun, Xuan Wang, WeiLi Zhang, Wenxuan Zhang, Yu Guo, Fei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a compositional method for constructing complete 3D head avatars from a single image that explicitly decouples hair from face, modeling them with distinct deformation paradigms for realistic hair dynamics during animation.

entry.title: Beyond Visual Cues: Semantic-Driven Token Filtering and Expert Routing for Anytime Person ReID

author.name: Jiaxuan Li, Xin Wen, Zhihang Li

entry.summary: STFER proposes semantic-driven token filtering and expert routing for anytime person re-identification, using Large Vision-Language Models to generate identity-consistent text that bridges modality shifts and clothing changes for robust retrieval.

entry.title: Differentiable Object Pose Connectivity Metrics for Regrasp Sequence Optimization

author.name: Liang Qin, Weiwei Wan, Kensuke Harada

entry.summary: Proposes a differentiable regrasp planning framework using Energy-Based Models to model grasp feasibility and enable gradient-based optimization of intermediate object poses for multi-step regrasp sequences, replacing brittle discrete search.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Retail Theft Detection via Orchestrated Vision Models: A Model-Agnostic, Cost-Effective Alternative to Trained Single-Model Systems

author.name: Haileab Yagersew

entry.summary: Presents Paza, a zero-shot retail theft detection framework that orchestrates multiple pre-existing models in a layered pipeline, using cheap detection continuously and expensive VLMs only when behavioral pre-filters trigger, reducing VLM calls by 240x.

entry.title: CoPA: Benchmarking Personalized Question Answering with Data-Informed Cognitive Factors

author.name: Hang Su, Zequn Liu, Chen Hu, Xuesong Lu, Yingce Xia, Zhen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces CoPA, a benchmark for personalized QA evaluation using data-mined Community-Individual Preference Divergence factors. Provides 1,985 user profiles for fine-grained personalization assessment.

entry.title: MapSR: Prompt-Driven Land Cover Map Super-Resolution via Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Ruiqi Wang, Qi Yu, Jie Ma, Hanlin Wu

entry.summary: MapSR proposes a prompt-driven framework for land cover map super-resolution that decouples supervision from model training. Uses frozen vision foundation model features with lightweight linear probes and training-free metric inference.

entry.title: Credo: Declarative Control of LLM Pipelines via Beliefs and Policies

author.name: Duo Lu, Andrew Crotty, U\u{g}ur \c{C}etintemel

entry.summary: Introduces Credo, a framework for controlling LLM pipelines through declarative beliefs and policies backed by a database semantic control plane, enabling adaptive, auditable, and composable agentic AI execution.

entry.title: Improving Machine Learning Performance with Synthetic Augmentation

author.name: Mel Sohm, Charles Dezons, Sami Sellami, Oscar Ninou, Axel Pincon

entry.summary: Formalizes synthetic data augmentation as a bias-variance trade-off in training distributions and introduces a size-matched null augmentation test and non-parametric block permutation test to evaluate whether synthetic data actually helps in financial ML.

entry.title: TRACER: Trace-Based Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing for LLM Classification

author.name: Adam Rida

entry.summary: Introduces TRACER, a system that trains lightweight ML surrogates on LLM production traces for classification tasks, deploying them only when agreement with the LLM exceeds a threshold, reducing costs while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: Rethinking Patient Education as Multi-turn Multi-modal Interaction

author.name: Zonghai Yao, Zhipeng Tang, Chengtao Lin, Xiong Luo, Benlu Wang, Juncheng Huang, Chin Siang Ong, Hong Yu

entry.summary: Introduces MedImageEdu, a benchmark for multi-turn, evidence-grounded radiology patient education where a DoctorAgent interacts with a PatientAgent conditioned on hidden profiles capturing patient factors.

entry.title: Sequence Search: Automated Sequence Design using Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Rokgi Hong, Hongjun An, Sooyeon Ji, Jongho Lee

entry.summary: Proposes 'Sequence Search,' an automated MR pulse sequence design framework based on neural architecture search that generates sequences from tissue properties and design objectives without requiring prior sequence knowledge.

entry.title: Hybrid Decision Making via Conformal VLM-generated Guidance

author.name: Debodeep Banerjee, Burcu Sayin, Stefano Teso, Andrea Passerini

entry.summary: Introduces ConfGuide, a hybrid decision-making approach using conformal risk control to generate succinct, targeted guidance from VLMs, improving upon existing approaches that compound information about all possible outcomes.

entry.title: Autogenesis: A Self-Evolving Agent Protocol

author.name: Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces the Autogenesis Protocol (AGP), a self-evolution protocol for LLM-based agent systems that decouples what evolves from how evolution occurs. It addresses shortcomings in existing agent protocols like A2A and MCP regarding lifecycle management, version tracking, and safe updates.

entry.title: Learning to Think Like a Cartoon Captionist: Incongruity-Resolution Supervision for Multimodal Humor Understanding

author.name: Hatice Merve Vural, Doga Kukul, Ege Erdem Ozlu, Demir Ekin Arikan, Bob Mankoff, Erkut Erdem, Aykut Erdem

entry.summary: Introduces IRS (Incongruity-Resolution Supervision), a framework decomposing humor understanding into incongruity modeling, resolution modeling, and preference alignment. Grounded in incongruity theory from cognitive science, applied to New Yorker Cartoon Caption Contest.

entry.title: Adaptive Query Routing: A Tier-Based Framework for Hybrid Retrieval Across Financial, Legal, and Medical Documents

author.name: Afshan Hashmi

entry.summary: Introduces Adaptive Hybrid Retrieval (AHR) combining vector RAG and tree reasoning for financial, legal, and medical documents. Proposes a tier-based routing framework for different query complexities.

entry.title: Explainable Graph Neural Networks for Interbank Contagion Surveillance: A Regulatory-Aligned Framework for the U.S. Banking Sector

author.name: Mohammad Nasir Uddin

entry.summary: Presents ST-GAT framework for interbank contagion surveillance using a Spatial-Temporal Graph Attention Network on 8,103 FDIC-insured institutions across 58 quarters. Achieves 0.939 AUPRC.

entry.title: Challenges and Future Directions in Agentic Reverse Engineering Systems

author.name: Salem Radey, Jack West, Kassem Fawaz

entry.summary: Examines challenges in agentic reverse engineering systems built on LLMs, identifying limitations including token constraints, struggles with obfuscation, and lack of guardrails. Outlines future research directions.

entry.title: FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge: Handling Uncertainties and Distribution Shifts for Precision Cosmology

author.name: Biwei Dai, Po-Wen Chang, Wahid Bhimji, Paolo Calafiura, Ragansu Chakkappai, Yuan-Tang Chou, Sascha Diefenbacher, Jordan Dudley, Ibrahim Elsharkawy, Steven Farrell, Isabelle Guyon, Chris Harris, Elham E Khoda, Benjamin Nachman, David Rousseau, Uro\v{s} Seljak, Ihsan Ullah, Yulei Zhang

entry.summary: Presents a machine learning challenge for weak gravitational lensing in cosmology, focusing on uncertainty quantification and distribution shifts. Addresses the gap between simulations and real observations for precision cosmological parameter estimation.

entry.title: Controllable Video Object Insertion via Multiview Priors

author.name: Xia Qi, Peishan Cong, Yichen Yao, Ziyi Wang, Yaoqin Ye, Yuexin Ma

entry.summary: Proposes a novel video object insertion method using multi-view object priors. Lifts 2D references into multi-view representations with a dual-path view-consistent conditioning mechanism for stable identity and occlusion handling.

entry.title: Seen-to-Scene: Keep the Seen, Generate the Unseen for Video Outpainting

author.name: Inseok Jeon, Minhyeok Lee, Seunghoon Lee, Minseok Kang, Suhwan Cho, Sangyoun Lee

entry.summary: Introduces Seen-to-Scene, a video outpainting framework unifying flow-based propagation with diffusion generation. Preserves visible content through propagation while generating unseen regions with proper temporal coherence.

entry.title: SOLIS: Physics-Informed Learning of Interpretable Neural Surrogates for Nonlinear Systems

author.name: Murat Furkan Mansur, Tufan Kumbasar

entry.summary: Proposes SOLIS for nonlinear system identification, modeling unknown dynamics via state-conditioned second-order surrogates recasted as Quasi-Linear Parameter-Varying representations. Bridges classical control-relevant identification with neural ODE expressiveness.

entry.title: When Fairness Metrics Disagree: Evaluating the Reliability of Demographic Fairness Assessment in Machine Learning

author.name: Khalid Adnan Alsayed

entry.summary: Conducts systematic multi-metric analysis of demographic fairness in ML, investigating consistency across different fairness metrics and finding they can produce conflicting assessments of the same system.

entry.title: MambaSL: Exploring Single-Layer Mamba for Time Series Classification

author.name: Yoo-Min Jung, Leekyung Kim

entry.summary: MambaSL proposes a minimal redesign of a single-layer Mamba model for time series classification, guided by TSC-specific hypotheses. It re-evaluates 20 baselines across all 30 UEA datasets under a unified protocol and achieves SOTA with statistically significant improvements.

entry.title: Why Do Vision Language Models Struggle To Recognize Human Emotions?

author.name: Madhav Agarwal, Sotirios A. Tsaftaris, Laura Sevilla-Lara, Steven McDonagh

entry.summary: Investigates why VLMs struggle with emotion recognition despite strong performance on other visual tasks, identifying long-tailed emotion distributions and temporal dynamics of facial expressions as two critical vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Quantization of Spiking Neural Networks Beyond Accuracy

author.name: Evan Gibson Smith, Jacob Whitehill, Fatemeh Ganji

entry.summary: Demonstrates that SNN quantization can produce substantially different firing distributions at equivalent accuracy, proposing Earth Mover's Distance as a metric to capture firing behavior preservation beyond accuracy.

entry.title: Continual Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Diagnosis via Functional Connectivity Matrices Generative Replay

author.name: Qianyu Chen, Shujian Yu

entry.summary: Presents the first continual learning framework for fMRI-based brain disorder diagnosis across sequential clinical sites, using a structure-aware VAE for generative replay of functional connectivity matrices.

entry.title: Timescale Separation Enables Deep Reinforcement Learning Control of Rotating Detonation Engine Mode Transitions

author.name: Kristian Holme, Jean Rabault, Ricardo Vinuesa, Mikael Mortensen

entry.summary: Applies deep RL to control rotating detonation engine mode transitions by reformulating the problem in a moving reference frame that makes wave structure quasi-steady, enabling effective timescale separation.

entry.title: H2VLR: Heterogeneous Hypergraph Vision-Language Reasoning for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Jianghong Huang, Luping Ji, Weiwei Duan, Mao Ye

entry.summary: Proposes H2VLR, a heterogeneous hypergraph framework for few-shot anomaly detection that combines vision-language models with high-order relational reasoning. Reformulates anomaly detection as hypergraph inference rather than simple pairwise matching.

entry.title: Exploiting Correlations in Federated Learning: Opportunities and Practical Limitations

author.name: Adrian Edin, Michel Kieffer, Mikael Johansson, Zheng Chen

entry.summary: Systematically classifies gradient and model compression in federated learning into structural, temporal, and spatial correlations. Proposes quantitative metrics and reinterprets existing methods through this unified framework.

entry.title: EviSearch: A Human in the Loop System for Extracting and Auditing Clinical Evidence for Systematic Reviews

author.name: Naman Ahuja, Saniya Mulla, Muhammad Ali Khan, Zaryab Bin Riaz, Kaneez Zahra Rubab Khakwani, Mohamad Bassam Sonbol, Irbaz Bin Riaz, Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: Presents EviSearch, a multi-agent system for extracting clinical evidence from trial PDFs for systematic reviews, with per-cell provenance tracking. Uses PDF-query and retrieval-guided agents with a reconciliation module.

entry.title: CobwebTM: Probabilistic Concept Formation for Lifelong and Hierarchical Topic Modeling

author.name: Karthik Singaravadivelan, Anant Gupta, Zekun Wang, Christopher MacLellan

entry.summary: Introduces CobwebTM, a lifelong hierarchical topic model based on incremental probabilistic concept formation. Constructs semantic hierarchies online without predefining topic numbers, addressing catastrophic forgetting in neural topic models.

entry.title: QuantCode-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Ability of Large Language Models to Generate Executable Algorithmic Trading Strategies

author.name: Alexey Khoroshilov, Alexey Chernysh, Orkhan Ekhtibarov, Nini Kamkia, Dmitry Zmitrovich

entry.summary: Introduces QuantCode-Bench, a benchmark of 400 tasks for evaluating LLMs on generating executable algorithmic trading strategies using the Backtrader framework. Requires domain-specific financial logic and API knowledge.

entry.title: WILD-SAM: Phase-Aware Expert Adaptation of SAM for Landslide Detection in Wrapped InSAR Interferograms

author.name: Yucheng Pan, Heping Li, Zhangle Liu, Sajid Hussain, Bin Pan

entry.summary: WILD-SAM adapts the Segment Anything Model (SAM) for landslide detection in wrapped InSAR interferograms through parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Addresses the spectral domain shift that suppresses high-frequency fringes essential for boundary delineation.

entry.title: M3D-Net: Multi-Modal 3D Facial Feature Reconstruction Network for Deepfake Detection

author.name: Haotian Wu, Yue Cheng, Shan Bian

entry.summary: M3D-Net proposes a dual-stream architecture for deepfake detection that reconstructs fine-grained facial geometry and reflectance properties from single-view RGB images via self-supervised 3D facial reconstruction, exploiting complementary multi-modal features.

entry.title: G-MIXER: Geodesic Mixup-based Implicit Semantic Expansion and Explicit Semantic Re-ranking for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Jiyoung Lim, Heejae Yang, Jee-Hyong Lee

entry.summary: G-MIXER addresses zero-shot composed image retrieval by introducing geodesic mixup-based implicit semantic expansion and explicit re-ranking. Tackles the over-reliance on textual modality in MLLM-based CIR methods that reduces retrieval diversity.

entry.title: Improved Multiscale Structural Mapping with Supervertex Vision Transformer for the Detection of Alzheimer's Disease Neurodegeneration

author.name: Geonwoo Baek, David H. Salat, Ikbeom Jang

entry.summary: Proposes MSSM+ with a Supervertex Vision Transformer for Alzheimer's disease detection from structural MRI, extending multiscale structural mapping to incorporate sulcal depth and cortical curvature alongside cortical thickness and gray-white matter contrasts.

entry.title: Prompt-to-Gesture: Measuring the Capabilities of Image-to-Video Deictic Gesture Generation

author.name: Hassan Ali, Doreen Jirak, Luca M\"uller, Stefan Wermter

entry.summary: Introduces and analyzes prompt-based video generation for creating synthetic deictic gesture datasets, investigating whether video generative AI models can augment traditional human-recorded gesture data. Addresses acute data scarcity in gesture recognition research.

entry.title: Building Extraction from Remote Sensing Imagery under Hazy and Low-light Conditions: Benchmark and Baseline

author.name: Feifei Sang, Wei Lu, Hongruixuan Chen, Sibao Chen, Bin Luo

entry.summary: Introduces HaLoBuilding, the first optical benchmark for building extraction under hazy and low-light conditions, along with HaLoBuild-Net, a framework for building extraction under degraded conditions using same-scene multitemporal pairing for label alignment.

entry.title: KVNN: Learnable Multi-Kernel Volterra Neural Networks

author.name: Haoyu Yun, Hamid Krim, Yufang Bao

entry.summary: Proposes kernelized Volterra Neural Networks (kVNN) with learnable multi-kernel representations for higher-order feature learning. Different interaction orders are modeled by distinct polynomial-kernel components with compact learnable centers.

entry.title: Unsupervised Skeleton-Based Action Segmentation via Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Vector Quantization

author.name: Umer Ahmed, Syed Ahmed Mahmood, Fawad Javed Fateh, M. Shaheer Luqman, M. Zeeshan Zia, Quoc-Huy Tran

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical spatiotemporal vector quantization framework for unsupervised skeleton-based temporal action segmentation with two levels: fine-grained subactions and action-level representations, exploiting both spatial and temporal cues.

entry.title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Exploits Passive Body Dynamics for High-Performance Biped Robot Locomotion

author.name: Tomoya Kamimura, Haruka Washiyama, Akihito Sano

entry.summary: Shows that incorporating passive body elements (springs) into biped robot design enables model-based deep RL to learn robust, energy-efficient walking and running locomotion through attractor-driven learning, compared to rigid humanoid models without passive elements.

entry.title: DEX-Mouse: A Low-cost Portable and Universal Interface with Force Feedback for Data Collection of Dexterous Robotic Hands

author.name: Joonho Koh, Haechan Jung, Nayoung Kim, Wook Ko, Changjoo Nam

entry.summary: Presents DEX-Mouse, a portable, calibration-free teleoperation interface for dexterous robotic hands with force feedback, built from commercial components under $150. Designed to be operator-agnostic and cross-platform compatible for efficient data collection.

entry.title: Pushing the Limits of On-Device Streaming ASR: A Compact, High-Accuracy English Model for Low-Latency Inference

author.name: Nenad Banfic, David Fan, Kunal Vaishnavi, Sam Kemp, Sunghoon Choi, Rui Ren, Sayan Shaw, Meng Tang

entry.summary: Systematic empirical study of on-device streaming ASR architectures, benchmarking 50+ configurations and identifying NVIDIA Nemotron as best for CPU-only edge deployment, then re-implementing and compressing it for practical use.

entry.title: AgentGA: Evolving Code Solutions in Agent-Seed Space

author.name: David Y. Y. Tan, Kellie Chin, Jingxian Zhang

entry.summary: Presents AgentGA, a genetic algorithm framework that evolves autonomous code-generation runs by optimizing the agent seed (task prompt + parent archives) rather than editing code directly, applied to tabular AutoML.

entry.title: Disentangle-then-Refine: LLM-Guided Decoupling and Structure-Aware Refinement for Graph Contrastive Learning

author.name: Zhaoxing Li, Hai-Feng Zhang, Xiaoming Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SDM-SCR, a framework for graph contrastive learning that uses LLMs to semantically disentangle signal from noise in text-attributed graphs, replacing random augmentations with semantic-aware decomposition.

entry.title: Benchmarks for Trajectory Safety Evaluation and Diagnosis in OpenClaw and Codex: ATBench-Claw and ATBench-CodeX

author.name: Zhonghao Yang, Yu Li, Yanxu Zhu, Tianyi Zhou, Yuejin Xie, Haoyu Luo, Jing Shao, Xia Hu, Dongrui Liu

entry.summary: Presents ATBench-Claw and ATBench-CodeX, domain-customized benchmarks for trajectory-level safety evaluation of agents in OpenClaw and OpenAI Codex settings, extending the ATBench framework.

entry.title: Cooperate to Compete: Strategic Data Generation and Incentivization Framework for Coopetitive Cross-Silo Federated Learning

author.name: Thanh Linh Nguyen, Nguyen Van Huynh, Quoc-Viet Pham

entry.summary: Proposes a coopetitive federated learning framework addressing the tension between cooperation during training and competition in downstream markets, with strategic data generation and incentivization mechanisms.

entry.title: Blue Data Intelligence Layer: Streaming Data and Agents for Multi-source Multi-modal Data-Centric Applications

author.name: Moin Aminnaseri, Farima Fatahi Bayat, Nikita Bhutani, Jean-Flavien Bussotti, Kevin Chan, Rafael Li Chen, Yanlin Feng, Jackson Hassell, Estevam Hruschka, Eser Kandogan, Hannah Kim, James Levine, Seiji Maekawa, Jalal Mahmud, Kushan Mitra, Naoki Otani, Pouya Pezeshkpour, Nima Shahbazi, Chen Shen, Dan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Blue's Data Intelligence Layer (DIL), an enterprise compound AI system for multi-source, multi-modal data interaction that goes beyond single NL2SQL queries to integrate heterogeneous data sources with contextual reasoning.

entry.title: HUOZIIME: An On-Device LLM-enhanced Input Method for Deep Personalization

author.name: Baocai Shan, Yuzhuang Xu, Wanxiang Che

entry.summary: Presents HUOZIIME, an on-device LLM-powered input method editor with deep personalization. Uses hierarchical memory for user-specific patterns and systematic optimizations for mobile deployment.

entry.title: Listen, Correct, and Feed Back: Spoken Pedagogical Feedback Generation

author.name: Junhong Liang, Yifan Lu, Ekaterina Kochmar, Fajri Koto
